Once there is around 8 minutes left of cooking time on the tofu, place your frying pan or wok over a medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. Stir fry the red pepper around 3-5 minutes until slightly softened, then add the panang curry sauce and the baby spinach. Stir to combine and cook until the sauce is piping hot and the spinach has wilted, around 3 minutes. Add 50-100ml water (double the amount for a four-person portion) if the sauce reduces too much or starts to stick. Finally, stir through the roasted tofu , squeeze in the juice of half of the lime and stir to combine. Season with salt to taste.
steps.label: Prep and cook curry
steps.notes: Start when tofu has 8 minutes left. Stir fry pepper 3-5 minutes, cook sauce and spinach 3 minutes, then stir in tofu and lime juice.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the jasmine rice between serving bowls and spoon over the curry and vegetables. Finish with a scattering of crushed peanuts , lime juice to taste and the red pepper garnish if you made some. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish curry
steps.notes: Divide rice, top with curry, and garnish with crushed peanuts, lime juice, and optional pepper.

title: Creamy Romesco Butter Beans With Lemon Charred Broccoli, Mint Pesto & Crushed Toasted Almonds
Creamy Saag Tofu 'Paneer' With Sweet Roasted Cherry Tomatoes & Soft Garlic Naan

steps.raw_text: Fresh iron-rich baby spinach is slowly cooked in coconut milk and tomato with garlic, cumin and garam masala
steps.label: Cook spinach curry
steps.notes: Slowly cook the baby spinach in the coconut milk and tomato mixture seasoned with garlic, cumin, and garam masala.

steps.raw_text: sweet bursting roasted cherry tomatoes
steps.label: Roast cherry tomatoes
steps.notes: Roast the cherry tomatoes until they are sweet and bursting.

steps.raw_text: then stirred through with a swirl of rich coconut cream.
steps.label: Stir in coconut cream
steps.notes: Stir a swirl of rich coconut cream through the cooked spinach curry.

steps.raw_text: Served with sweet bursting roasted cherry tomatoes and a scattering of fresh coriander, with a pillowy soft garlic and herb naan
steps.label: Assemble and serve
steps.notes: Serve the creamy saag curry topped with the roasted cherry tomatoes, scattered fresh coriander, and warm garlic naan.

title: High Protein Creamy Squash Bucatini With Wilted Cavolo Nero & Crispy Tempeh 'Pancetta'
Creamy Tomato Butter Beans With Baby Spinach, Almond Gremolata & Pillowy Soft Garlic & Herb Flatbread

steps.raw_text: Take out a small frying pan and a large saucepan or deep frying pan.
steps.label: Gather frying pans and saucepan
steps.notes: Prepare the cooking vessels for the tomatoes and beans.

steps.raw_text: Add the cherry tomatoes to your small frying pan with a good drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and cook on a medium heat for 4-5 mins, adding a splash or two of water if they start to dry out. They should start to split and blister, releasing some of their juices.
steps.label: Cook and blister cherry tomatoes
steps.notes: Cook for 4-5 minutes on medium heat until they split and blister. Add water if they dry out.

steps.raw_text: Add the tin of butter beans with half of the liquid to your other large saucepan or deep frying pan along with the creamy tomato sauce and simmer for 4-5 mins over medium heat. Add the spinach in the last couple of minutes to wilt. Add a splash of water if you would like it to be more creamy.
steps.label: Simmer butter beans and spinach
steps.notes: Simmer beans for 4-5 minutes. Add spinach in the last 2 minutes to wilt.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, toast the flatbreads in the oven or in a hot, dry pan on one side. Add a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of salt if you like. Cut into quarters.
steps.label: Toast and cut the flatbreads
steps.notes: Toast on one side in the oven or a hot, dry pan, then cut into quarters.

steps.raw_text: To serve, ladle the creamy tomato beans into bowls, top with the blistered cherry tomatoes and drizzle over the gremolata dressing. Serve the flatbread alongside and use them to scoop it all up. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve with flatbread
steps.notes: Ladle beans into bowls, top with tomatoes and gremolata, and serve with flatbread.

title: Creamy Tomato Daal With Charred Cauliflower, Crispy Kale, Coconut Yoghurt & Fluffy Rice

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 220°C fan, then take out a large roasting tray and two saucepans.
steps.label: Preheat oven and gather pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C or 220°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Cut the cauliflower into bitesized chunks, place into your roasting tray and toss with olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 15-20 minutes or until tender in the centre and nicely charred on the outside.
steps.label: Prep and roast cauliflower
steps.notes: Roast for 15-20 minutes (midpoint 17.5, rounded to 18) until tender in the centre and nicely charred.

steps.raw_text: Empty the tomato daal sauce into your saucepan along with the red lentils and 250ml of water. Cook the daal over a medium heat for around until the lentils are tender and cooked through, around 10-15 minutes. Stir regularly to stop the lentils from sticking to the bottom of the pan. Once cooked, squeeze in half of the lime and season to taste with salt.
steps.label: Cook tomato daal
steps.notes: Cook for 10-15 minutes (midpoint 12.5, rounded to 13) until lentils are tender. Stir regularly to prevent sticking.

steps.raw_text: Place the rice in a small saucepan and cover with 2.5x its volume in water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and cover. Cook for 8-10 minutes or until the rice is tender, but al dente.
steps.label: Cook the rice
steps.notes: Cook for 8-10 minutes (midpoint 9) until tender but al dente.

steps.raw_text: Remove any hardy stems from the cavolo nero , then finely slice the leaves. Once there is 10 minutes left on the roasted cauliflower, add the sliced cavolo nero to one side of the roasting tray, toss in a little olive oil and some salt and roast for the final 10 minutes of cooking time. Check the cavolo nero after 5 minutes to make sure it doesn't burn. Meanwhile roughly chop the coriander leaves.
steps.label: Prep and roast cavolo nero
steps.notes: Add cavolo nero to the tray when 10 minutes remain on the cauliflower. Roast for 10 minutes, checking after 5 minutes. Chop coriander meanwhile.

steps.raw_text: Divide the tomato daal and rice between serving bowls, then top with the charred cauliflower , crispy cavolo nero and a dollop of coconut yoghurt . Garnish with chopped coriander , the rest of the lime juice and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish daal
steps.notes: Divide daal and rice, top with cauliflower, cavolo nero, yoghurt, coriander, and remaining lime.

title: Creamy Vietnamese Coconut Curry With Tofu, Sweet Potato, Crispy Shallots, Pickled Radish, Cashews & Sesame Seeds
Crispy Baja Tofish Tacos With Shredded Cabbage, Zingy Salsa Fresca & Smokey Chipotle Mayo On Soft Corn Tortillas
Crispy Buffalo Tofu Nourish Bowl With Cabbage Celery Slaw, Tricolour Quinoa, Pink Onion Pickle & Ranch Dressing

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a large frying pan, a medium-size saucepan to cook quinoa and a small sauce pan to warm up the sauce. Fill the medium-size saucepan with boiling water from the kettle and place it over a medium heat to bring back to the boil.
steps.label: Boil kettle and heat saucepan
steps.notes: Boil kettle, set up pans, and bring saucepan water to a boil over medium heat.

steps.raw_text: Cook the red & white quinoa in the saucepan until al dente, around 8 minutes. Drain, then leave it in a sieve over the saucepan to ensure it drains really well while you prepare the rest of the dish.
steps.label: Cook and drain quinoa
steps.notes: Cook for around 8 minutes until al dente, then leave to drain in a sieve over the saucepan.

steps.raw_text: To make the cabbage and celery slaw, finely shred the white cabbage (use a mandoline if you have one) and finely slice the celery stick into similar thin strips using a sharp knife. Combine them in a mixing bowl and drizzle in half of the cashew ranch sauce . Mix well, season to taste with salt and pepper, and set aside.
steps.label: Prepare cabbage and celery slaw
steps.notes: Finely shred cabbage and slice celery. Mix with half of the cashew ranch sauce, season, and set aside.

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks using your hands. Heat a drizzle of oil in your frying pan over a medium heat. Add the tofu and fry until golden and crispy on all sides, around 10 minutes. In the meantime add the buffalo sauce to the small saucepan and gently warm it on low heat until it melts, then drizzle over the crispy tofu in the frying pan, and stir until well coated.
steps.label: Fry tofu and warm sauce
steps.notes: Fry torn tofu for around 10 minutes until golden and crispy. Warm buffalo sauce on low heat, then coat the tofu.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the quinoa between serving bowls and top with the crispy buffalo tofu, spooning over any remaining sauce. Add the slaw and red wine vinegar pickled red onion on the side, and finish with a drizzle of the remaining cashew ranch sauce . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve nourish bowls
steps.notes: Divide quinoa, top with tofu, remaining sauce, slaw, pickled onion, and a drizzle of ranch.

title: Crispy Buffalo Tofu Tacos With Cooling Ranch Dressing, Shredded Cabbage & Juicy Pineapple

steps.raw_text: All you need to finish this dish is a large frying pan.
steps.label: Prepare the large frying pan
steps.notes: Ensure the large frying pan is clean and ready for use.

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks with your hands, then place into a small bowl with the cornflour and season well with salt and pepper. Mix carefully with your hands to coat the tofu in the cornflour. Add a drizzle of oil to your frying pan and place over a medium-high heat. Once hot, add the tofu and fry on all sides until golden and crispy. Alternatively, toss in a little oil and air fry for 15 minutes, tossing every 5 minutes.
steps.label: Prep and fry the tofu
steps.notes: Fry on all sides until golden and crispy, or air fry for 15 minutes tossing every 5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile slice the red cabbage as thinly as you can (use a mandolin if you have one). Roughly chop the coriander . Roughly chop the pineapple into smaller pieces. Give the cashew ranch sauce a shake in its pouch before opening in case it has separated while sitting in the fridge.
steps.label: Prep cabbage, coriander, pineapple, and sauce
steps.notes: Slice cabbage as thinly as possible. Shake the sauce pouch before opening.

steps.raw_text: When the tofu is ready, remove it from the pan and place it into a bowl and toss with the buffalo sauce to coat evenly. You may want to run the sauce pouch under warm water to loosen the texture before opening.
steps.label: Toss tofu in buffalo sauce
steps.notes: Run the sauce pouch under warm water to loosen texture before opening if needed.

steps.raw_text: Wipe your frying pan clean with some kitchen towel, then dry-fry the tacos (without oil) for 10–20 seconds on each side, or until warm and soft. Add a sprinkle of water if you’d like them extra soft.
steps.label: Dry-fry the tacos
steps.notes: Dry-fry for 10-20 seconds on each side. Sprinkle with water for extra softness.

steps.raw_text: Divide the tacos between serving plates, then pile up with the crispy buffalo tofu , a drizzle of cashew ranch sauce , the red cabbage and pineapple . Finish with a scattering of coriander to garnish and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish the tacos
steps.notes: Layer tacos with tofu, ranch, cabbage, pineapple, and garnish with coriander.

title: Crispy Buffalo Tofu Wrap With Creamy Cashew Blue 'Cheese' Ranch Sauce, Avocado & Rainbow Slaw

steps.raw_text: All you need to finish this dish is a large frying pan.
steps.label: Prepare the required frying pan
steps.notes: Ensure a large frying pan is ready for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks with your hands, then place into a small bowl with the cornflour and season well with salt and pepper. Mix carefully with your hands to coat the tofu in the cornflour. Add a drizzle of oil to your frying pan and place over a medium-high heat. Once hot, add the tofu and fry on all sides until golden and crispy. Alternatively, toss in a little oil and air fry for 15 minutes, tossing every 5 minutes.
steps.label: Coat and fry the tofu
steps.notes: Fry until golden and crispy, or alternatively air fry for 15 minutes, tossing every 5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, slice the red cabbage as thinly as you can and julienne the carrot (use a mandolin if you have one). Remove the stone and skin from the avocado and thinly slice it. Give the cashew ranch sauce a shake in its pouch before opening, in case it has separated while sitting in the fridge.
steps.label: Prep the vegetables and sauce
steps.notes: Slice cabbage thinly, julienne carrot, slice avocado, and shake the ranch pouch.

steps.raw_text: When the tofu is ready, remove it from the pan and place it into a bowl and toss with the buffalo sauce to coat evenly. You may want to run the sauce pouch under warm water to loosen the texture before opening.
steps.label: Toss tofu in buffalo sauce
steps.notes: Toss tofu in buffalo sauce. Run the sauce pouch under warm water first if needed to loosen texture.

steps.raw_text: Wipe your frying pan clean with some kitchen towel, then dry-fry the flour tortillas (without oil) for 10–20 seconds on each side, or until warm and soft.
steps.label: Warm the flour tortillas
steps.notes: Wipe the pan clean, then dry-fry tortillas for 10-20 seconds on each side until warm and soft.

steps.raw_text: To serve, place a flour tortilla on each serving plate, then add the sliced red cabbage and julienned carrot to the bottom half. Top with the crispy buffalo tofu and sliced avocado , then drizzle over the cashew ranch sauce . Fold the sides of the tortilla toward the centre, roll it up tightly from the bottom, and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve the wraps
steps.notes: Layer cabbage, carrot, tofu, avocado, and ranch sauce, then fold and roll tightly.

title: Crispy Cauliflower Gnocchi With Puttanesca Sauce, Crispy Kale & Fresh Parsley

steps.raw_text: Take out a saucepan, two roasting trays and preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C or 180°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Place the cauliflower gnocchi in in one of your roasting trays with a drizzle of olive oil and toss to coat. Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, turning the gnocchi halfway through to ensure both sides are evenly browned. Make sure the gnocchi are well coated in oil and spaced out in the tray so they can become golden all over. NB: Do not boil this gluten-free gnocchi. It is easy to overcook and they can become soggy. Oven baking gives the best result for this recipe. Alternatively, you can fry them in a wide non-stick pan with oil for 5–6 minutes, or until golden.
steps.label: Bake cauliflower gnocchi
steps.notes: Bake for 15 minutes, turning halfway. Do not boil. Alternatively, pan-fry for 5-6 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Strip the leaves from the kale by pulling them down and away from the stalk. Roughly chop the leaves, place them in the other roasting trays, then toss with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Add to the oven and bake for 8–10 minutes, or until crispy. Oven temperatures may vary, so check halfway through to ensure it is not burning.
steps.label: Prep and bake kale
steps.notes: Bake for 8-10 minutes (midpoint 9) until crispy. Check halfway to prevent burning.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over medium heat, add the red lentils along with 300ml of water, and bring to a boil. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and absorbed most of the water. Add the puttanesca sauce , mix well, and cook for a further 2–3 minutes until the sauce is simmering. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste. Meanwhile, finely chop the parsley for garnish.
steps.label: Cook lentils, sauce, and chop parsley
steps.notes: Cook lentils for 10 minutes, then simmer with sauce for 2-3 minutes (midpoint 2.5, total ~13 mins). Chop parsley meanwhile.

steps.raw_text: Once the gnocchi are crispy and ready, remove them from the oven and fold them into the puttanesca sauce , mixing well. Divide between serving bowls, scatter over the chopped parsley , and serve the crispy kale on the side. Enjoy!
steps.label: Combine, plate, and serve
steps.notes: Fold gnocchi into sauce, plate, garnish with parsley, and serve with kale on the side.

title: Crispy Chilli Tofu With Toasted Cashews, Short Grain Brown Rice, Sesame Hispi & Pear Slaw & Cucumber Pickle

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a frying pan, a saucepan, and a mixing bowl.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and gather all necessary pans and bowls to start.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over medium-high heat and fill it with boiling water from the kettle. Add the short grain brown rice , bring it back to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium. Simmer for 15-18 minutes, until the rice is tender but still al dente. Once ready, remove from the heat, drain any excess water, then return the rice to your saucepan. Cover with a lid to steam and keep warm.
steps.label: Cook short grain brown rice
steps.notes: Simmer for 15-18 minutes until tender but al dente, then drain and cover to steam.

steps.raw_text: Thinly slice the hispi cabbage and add it to your mixing bowl. Toss with a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cut the pear in half, remove the cores and seeds, then cut them into thin matchstick-like strips about 2-3mm thick (julienne). Add the pear to the seasoned cabbage and toss to combine. You may want to add a splash of the pickle juice from the pickled cucumber in this meal kit for a touch of acidity. If your hispi cabbage is particularly large, you may only need to use half for this meal. Any leftover slaw can be stored in a sealed container in the fridge and enjoyed the following day.
steps.label: Prepare hispi and pear slaw
steps.notes: Slice cabbage and julienne pear to 2-3mm thick. Optionally add pickle juice for acidity.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium heat and dry-toast the cashews (without oil) for 2-3 minutes, until lightly golden. Remove from your pan and set aside for garnish.
steps.label: Dry-toast the cashews
steps.notes: Toast without oil for 2-3 minutes until lightly golden, then set aside.

steps.raw_text: Return your frying pan to medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil (we recommend toasted sesame oil for extra flavour). Tear the tofu into bitesized pieces with your hands, then place into a bowl and toss through the cornflour until evenly coated. Cook for 5-6 minutes, until the edges start to become golden and crispy. Remove from the pan and set aside, then add the sticky chilli sauce cook for 3-4 minutes, until the sauce thickens and starts to caramelise. Turn off the heat and stir through the crispy tofu until well coated in the sauce.
steps.label: Cook tofu and thicken sauce
steps.notes: Tear tofu and coat in cornflour. Cook tofu for 5-6 minutes, then cook sauce for 3-4 minutes before coating.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the short grain brown rice between serving bowls and top with the sticky chilli tofu . Serve the hispi & pear slaw , along with the pickled cucumber , on the side. Finish with a sprinkle of the sesame garnish and the toasted cashews , and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the dish
steps.notes: Assemble rice, tofu, slaw, and pickled cucumber. Garnish with sesame seeds and toasted cashews.

title: Crispy Chipotle Pumpkin & Black Bean Tacos With Melted 'Mozzarella', Guacamole & Pink Onion Pickles

steps.raw_text: Finely slice the red onion and place into a small bowl. If it’s a large onion, half for two people will work well. Squeeze over half of the lime and season with salt. Give the onions a quick mix and leave to pickle while you make the tacos.
steps.label: Slice and pickle red onion
steps.notes: Leave the onions to pickle in the lime juice and salt while you prepare the rest of the meal.

steps.raw_text: Drain the black beans and add to a small-medium sized bowl. Mash them up with a potato masher or fork until you have a chunky paste that binds together more, then stir through the chipotle pumpkin sauce and the zest of half the lime . Season with salt and pepper. Thinly slice the plant-based mozzarella .
steps.label: Mash beans and slice mozzarella
steps.notes: Mash the black beans until they form a chunky, binding paste before stirring in the sauce, lime zest, and seasoning.

steps.raw_text: Wrap the corn tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for about 30 seconds. This makes them more pliable and prevents cracking or breaking when folding. If you don’t have a microwave you could warm each tortilla in a frying pan without oil for 20 seconds before filling it. To fill the tacos, spread some of the chipotle pumpkin and black bean mix onto each of the tacos leaving 0.5cm of space around the edge. Divide the mozzarella between them all, then fold them over in half. Add a drizzle of oil to your frying pan and place over a medium heat. Once hot, fry the tacos for around 2 minutes on each side, or until golden and crispy. You may need to cook them in batches.
steps.label: Warm, fill, and fry tacos
steps.notes: Microwave tortillas for 30 seconds in a damp paper towel (or warm in a dry pan for 20 seconds). Fry filled tacos for about 2 minutes per side over medium heat until golden and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Make your guacamole while the tacos cook. Pit the avocado and finely chop the coriander . Place the avocado into a small bowl and mash it up with a fork. Add half of the coriander , the remaining half of lime juice and season well with salt. You could also add a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
steps.label: Make the guacamole
steps.notes: Prepare this while the tacos are frying. Uses the remaining half of the lime juice and half of the chopped coriander.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the tacos between serving bowls, serve the guacamole and pickles alongside and garnish with the remaining coriander . We recommend scooping a little guac and pickles onto the tacos as you eat them. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish tacos
steps.notes: Garnish with the remaining coriander and serve with guacamole and pickled onions on the side.

title: Crispy Courgette & Sweetcorn Fritters With Garlic & Dill Yoghurt and Sweet Cucumber Pickle
Crispy Gochujang Cauliflower With Edamame, Julienned Vegetables & Vermicelli Noodles

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a wok (any deep pan will work if you don't have a wok) and a frying pan. Julienne or grate the carrot . Finely slice the red cabbage (use a mandolin if you have one) and spring onions , separating the whites and greens.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prep vegetables
steps.notes: Boil kettle first. Julienne or grate carrot, finely slice cabbage and spring onions, separating whites and greens.

steps.raw_text: Place the vermicelli noodles into a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water from your kettle and leave the noodles to cook for 5 minutes or until tender.
steps.label: Soak vermicelli noodles
steps.notes: Cover noodles with boiling water and leave to cook for 5 minutes or until tender.

steps.raw_text: Take two bowls and pour some plant milk into one (water works as well if you don't have any), and the cornflour into the other. Season the cornflour generously with salt and pepper, but be sure to set aside one teaspoon of it for later, as you'll need it to thicken the sauce. Cut the cauliflower florets into bite-sized pieces, and toss them in the plant milk to coat, then dredge in the cornflour until thickly coated.
steps.label: Prep and coat cauliflower
steps.notes: Be sure to set aside 1 teaspoon of cornflour for later to thicken the sauce. Cut cauliflower into bite-sized pieces, coat in milk, and dredge in seasoned cornflour.

steps.raw_text: There are three ways to cook the cauliflower : 1. For the crispiest cauliflower (similar to the above image), shallow fry 1cm of neutral oil (e.g. sunflower, groundnut, vegetable but not olive oil) in a deep pan over a medium high heat until golden and crispy, around 5-8 minutes. 2. Air fry for 15-20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes. We recommend brushing them with a little oil to help them turn more golden and crispy. 3. Roast in the oven at 200°C for 20-30 minutes or until golden.
steps.label: Cook the cauliflower
steps.notes: Three cooking options: shallow fry for 5-8 minutes (default 7 mins), air fry for 15-20 minutes, or roast in the oven at 200°C for 20-30 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Once there’s 2-3 minutes remaining on the cauliflower, place your other frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil. Once hot, toss in the carrots , cabbage , edamame and the white spring onions. Sauté until softened a little but still with some bite, around 2-3 minutes. Open the gochujang sauce pouch and add the reserved teaspoon of cornflour directly into the bag and carefully stir with a spoon until there are no lumps. Add it to the pan cook for about 1 minute, until thickened.
steps.label: Sauté vegetables and add sauce
steps.notes: Start when 2-3 minutes remain on the cauliflower. Sauté veg for 2-3 minutes. Mix reserved cornflour into the gochujang pouch, add to pan, and cook for 1 minute until thickened.

steps.raw_text: Take the sauce and vegetables off the heat (to keep the cauliflower crispy), then add the crispy cauliflower to the pan. Stir gently until the cauliflower is evenly coated. Divide the vermicelli noodles between serving bowls, top with the gochujang cauliflower and vegetables and finish with a garnish of sesame garnish and green spring onions . Enjoy!
steps.label: Combine, plate, and garnish
steps.notes: Take veg off the heat before adding cauliflower to keep it crispy. Toss gently, divide noodles into bowls, top with cauliflower and veg, and garnish with sesame and green spring onions.

title: Gut-Friendly Gochujang Tempeh Over Savoy Cabbage Slaw With Fluffy Quinoa, Tahini Dressing & Omega 3 Seed Mix
Crispy Gochujang Tofu Bowl With Cucumber Pickle, Creamy Avocado & Toasted Sesame Seeds

steps.raw_text: Take out a saucepan and a large frying pan.
steps.label: Prepare cooking pans
steps.notes: Retrieve the saucepan and large frying pan to begin.

steps.raw_text: Rinse the sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Add to a saucepan with 1.25~1.5x its volume of cold water and, if you have time, leave to soak for 10–15 minutes. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes without lifting the lid. Turn off the heat and leave to steam, covered, until ready to serve.
steps.label: Rinse and cook sushi rice
steps.notes: Optional 10-15 minute soak. Cook covered for 10 minutes, then turn off heat and steam covered until serving.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, tear the tofu into bitesized chunks. Empty the cornflour into a bowl, season with salt and pepper, then add the tofu and mix until it's evenly coated. Place your frying pan over a medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. Fry the tofu until crispy and golden on all sides (approx 8-10 minutes), then remove and set aside. Add the gochujang sauce to the pan and cook for 30-60 seconds to thicken up a little, then turn off the pan and add the tofu back in and stir through. Alternatively if you like, you could add the sauce in with the tofu and cook for 30-60 seconds, but the method above keeps the tofu nice and crispy.
steps.label: Prep and fry gochujang tofu
steps.notes: Fry tofu for 8-10 minutes until crispy and golden. Cook sauce for 30-60 seconds to thicken before tossing tofu back in.

steps.raw_text: Julienne or grate the carrots . Remove the flesh from the avocado and dice into bite-sized pieces.
steps.label: Prep carrots and avocado
steps.notes: Julienne or grate the carrots, and dice the avocado flesh.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the sushi rice between serving bowls, top with the crispy gochujang tofu , then divide up the carrots , avocado and pickled cucumber . Finish everything with a sprinkle of the sesame garnish and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish bowls
steps.notes: Divide rice, tofu, carrots, avocado, and pickled cucumber into bowls. Finish with sesame garnish.

title: Crispy Korean Oyster Mushroom Burger With Kimchi & Gochujang Mayo On Soft Vegan Brioche

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan, then take out a large roasting tray and a wok or deep frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat to 220°C or 200°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Cut the new potatoes into 1-1.5 square cm pieces. Place into your roasting tray, then drizzle with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden and crispy.
steps.label: Chop and roast new potatoes
steps.notes: Roast for 15-20 minutes until golden and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Place the dry mix into a bowl and measure out 100ml of plant milk (or water if you don’t have milk). Slowly add the milk and stir until you have a thick batter (you may need slightly less or more than 100ml). Season well with salt and pepper and stir thoroughly until combined. Place the panko breadcrumbs into a separate bowl and season well with salt and pepper. Dip the oyster mushrooms into the batter mix and then into the panko breadcrumbs to coat.
steps.label: Batter and bread oyster mushrooms
steps.notes: Adjust milk amount to achieve a thick batter.

steps.raw_text: Heat 1cm of a neutral oil (e.g. sunflower, groundnut or vegetable, but not olive oil) in a wok or deep frying pan, then fry the oyster mushrooms until golden on all sides, around 5-10 minutes. Alternatively you can brush with a little oil and air fry for 10-15 minutes or bake in the oven for 20-30 minutes. Remove and place into a bowl lined with kitchen towel, allowing them to cool slightly before serving.
steps.label: Fry the coated oyster mushrooms
steps.notes: Fry for 5-10 minutes. Alternatively, air fry for 10-15 minutes or bake for 20-30 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Finely slice the baby gem lettuce . Slice the vegan brioche in half and toast in a frying pan just before serving.
steps.label: Slice lettuce and toast brioche
steps.notes: Toast the brioche just before serving.

steps.raw_text: To serve, spread a layer of gochujang mayo on the top and bottom of the brioche, then pile in some baby gem lettuce , crispy oyster mushrooms and kimchi . Serve alongside the crispy potatoes with any extra gochujang mayo for dipping. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble burgers and serve
steps.notes: Layer gochujang mayo, lettuce, mushrooms, and kimchi. Serve with roasted potatoes.

title: Crispy Korean Pancakes With Mixed Vegetables, Dipping Sauce, Smacked Cucumber & Kimchi Brown Rice

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a saucepan, a mixing bowl, and two small nonstick frying pans. This will help both pancakes cook at the same time. Alternatively, you can use one frying pan and repeat the cooking process in STEP 6.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and gather all necessary pans and bowls to streamline the cooking process.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over medium-high heat and fill it with boiling water from the kettle. Add the short grain brown rice , bring it back to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium. Simmer for 15-18 minutes, until the rice is tender but still al dente. Once ready, remove from the heat, drain any excess water, then return the rice to your saucepan. Cover with a lid to steam and keep warm.
steps.label: Cook brown rice
steps.notes: Simmer range is 15-18 minutes (midpoint used). Cover with a lid to steam and keep warm once drained.

steps.raw_text: Trim the ends of the baby cucumber and lightly smash it using a rolling pin or the bottom of a jar, then slice it into bite-sized pieces. Add it to a small serving bowl and toss with a couple of spoonfuls of the gochugaru sesame dressing . Leave to marinate.
steps.label: Prepare smashed cucumber salad
steps.notes: Lightly smash the cucumber before slicing to help it absorb the gochugaru sesame dressing while marinating.

steps.raw_text: Add the pancake batter to your mixing bowl and pour in 220ml of water (double for 4 portions) along with a teaspoon of oil, salt and pepper, then mix until smooth. You can also add some of the liquid from the kimchi for extra flavour, and the acidity will help activate the baking powder in the batter. Set aside to rest.
steps.label: Mix pancake batter
steps.notes: Mix until smooth. Optionally add kimchi liquid to help activate the baking powder and add flavor. Set aside to rest.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, peel and trim the carrot , and trim the courgette . Cut them into thin matchstick-like strips about 2-3mm thick (julienne). Use a mandoline if you have one for even slices of carrot and courgette. Separate the white and green parts of the spring onions , then finely slice them. Set aside the green parts for garnish, and add the carrot, courgette, and white parts of the spring onions to your prepared pancake batter. Mix until well combined.
steps.label: Prep vegetables and mix into batter
steps.notes: Julienne carrots and courgettes to 2-3mm thick. Reserve green spring onion parts for garnish and mix the rest into the batter.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pans over medium heat and add enough oil to coat the bases. Once hot, add half of the pancake and vegetable mixture to each frying pan and spread thinly into circles using the back of a ladle. Cook untouched for 3-4 minutes, until the bottoms form a crust, then flip and cook for a further 3-4 minutes until crispy and golden brown. If you are using one frying pan, or cooking for 4 people, repeat the process.
steps.label: Fry the pancakes
steps.notes: Cook untouched for 3-4 minutes per side (midpoint used) until a crust forms and they are crispy and golden. Repeat if using only one pan.

steps.raw_text: Serve the korean pancakes on serving plates and garnish with the reserved spring onion and a sprinkle of the sesame garnish . Serve alongside a small bowl of the gochugaru sesame dressing for dipping, the kimchi and the smashed cucumber salad . The brown rice can be enjoyed as it is between bites of the pancakes, or, if you have toasted sesame oil and soy sauce to hand, toss it with some of the kimchi and a light drizzle of each for extra flavour. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve
steps.notes: Garnish pancakes with spring onion and sesame. Serve with dipping sauce, kimchi, cucumber salad, and brown rice.

title: High Protein Lebanese Tofu Nourish Bowl With Quinoa Tabbouleh, Green Tahini Sauce & Pink Pickled Onion

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a large frying pan and a saucepan. Fill your saucepan with boiling water from your kettle and place over a medium heat to bring to the boil.
steps.label: Boil kettle and heat saucepan
steps.notes: Bring saucepan of water to a boil over medium heat.

steps.raw_text: Cook the quinoa in your saucepan with boiling water until al dente, around 8 minutes. Drain and put it aside on a sieve over the saucepan to make sure it's drained very well while you prepare the rest of the dish.
steps.label: Cook and drain quinoa
steps.notes: Cook for around 8 minutes until al dente, then drain thoroughly over the saucepan.

steps.raw_text: Cut the tofu into two blocks, lengthwise. Use a peeler or the slicer on a cheese grater to peel each block into thick ribbons (or slice very thinly with a sharp knife). Place the tofu into a container or bowl. Mix 2 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil with the tofu spice mix and stir to combine. Pour this over the tofu and gently toss to make sure it's all evenly covered.
steps.label: Slice and marinate tofu
steps.notes: Peel or slice tofu into thick ribbons, then toss with olive oil and spice mix.

steps.raw_text: Heat your large frying pan on medium heat and fry the tofu for 4-6 mins until starting to brown on the edges. Take care not to overcook it as it could become too crispy - the slices should still be soft in the middle. Taste and season with more salt and pepper if you like.
steps.label: Fry the tofu ribbons
steps.notes: Fry for 4-6 minutes (midpoint 5 mins) on medium heat until edges brown but centers remain soft.

steps.raw_text: Finely chop the parsley , cut the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the cucumber . Add them to a mixing bowl with the quinoa . Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil . season well with salt and pepper and give everything a good mix.
steps.label: Chop vegetables and mix salad
steps.notes: Finely chop parsley, cut tomatoes, slice cucumber, and mix with the drained quinoa and olive oil.

steps.raw_text: Spoon the salad into bowls and top with the tofu. Pour over the herby tahini yoghurt and top with the pink pickled onions .
steps.label: Assemble and garnish bowls
steps.notes: Spoon salad into bowls, top with tofu, herby tahini yoghurt, and pink pickled onions.

title: Crispy Rice Salad With Smacked Cucumber, Avocado, Edamame, Black Beans, Toasted Cashews, Chilli & Satay Dressing

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Boil your kettle, then take out a saucepan, a roasting tray, and a large mixing bowl.
steps.label: Preheat oven and boil kettle
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan. Boil kettle for the next steps.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over medium heat and pour in the boiling water from your kettle. Boil the edamame for 1 minute, then drain and set aside.
steps.label: Boil and drain edamame
steps.notes: Boil the edamame for exactly 1 minute, then drain and set aside.

steps.raw_text: Place the saucepan you used for boiling the edamame back on the hob. Add the basmati rice and cover with 2 times its volume in water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 9–10 minutes, until the water has been absorbed and the rice is al dente. Once ready, remove from the heat and fluff up with a fork to release the steam. Add half of the chilli oil and mix well. Line your roasting tray with parchment paper and spread the rice mixture in a thin layer. You may want to brush or spray a little oil over the rice for extra crispiness. Place in the oven and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until the rice is crispy. Add the cashews for the final 5-10 minutes to toast.
steps.label: Cook rice and bake until crispy
steps.notes: Simmer rice for 9–10 minutes, then bake for 15–20 minutes. Add cashews for the final 5–10 minutes to toast.

steps.raw_text: Trim the ends of the cucumber, and place it on a chopping board. Smash it gently along the length using a rolling pin or a heavy pestle until it splits, then chop diagonally into bite-sized chunks. Place into a large mixing bowl and toss through the remaining chilli oil .
steps.label: Smash and chop cucumber
steps.notes: Smash gently with a rolling pin or heavy pestle until it splits, then chop diagonally.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, peel, de-stone, and dice the avocado into bite-sized pieces. Drain and rinse the black beans . Finely slice the spring onions . When the crispy rice is ready, add the rice , spring onion , avocado , black beans and edamame to the mixing bowl with the smacked cucumber and mix everything together.
steps.label: Prep veg and mix salad
steps.notes: Prep the avocado, black beans, and spring onions while the rice cooks. Combine everything once the crispy rice is ready.

steps.raw_text: Divide the crispy rice salad between serving bowls, top with the toasted cashews , drizzle over the satay dressing , and enjoy.
steps.label: Portion and garnish salad
steps.notes: Divide into bowls, top with toasted cashews, and drizzle with satay dressing.

title: Crispy Sweet Potato & Black Bean Taquitos With Cashew 'Feta' Crema & Salsa Fresca

steps.raw_text: For the best flavour and texture, we recommend shallow frying the taquitos, but if you'd prefer a healthier oil free version you can bake them instead. If you are frying, take out a deep frying pan or wok. If you are baking, pre-heat your oven to 200°C / 220°C fan and take out a roasting tray.
steps.label: Prepare cooking equipment and preheat oven
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C (220°C fan) if baking, or prepare a frying pan or wok if shallow frying.

steps.raw_text: Drain the black beans and add to a large bowl. Mash them up with a potato masher or fork until you have a chunky paste that binds together more, then stir through the chipotle sweet potato . Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Mash beans and mix filling
steps.notes: Mash the drained black beans to a chunky paste before stirring in the chipotle sweet potato.

steps.raw_text: Wrap the corn tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for about 30 seconds. This makes them more pliable and prevents cracking or breaking when folding. If you don’t have a microwave you can add a splash of water to each side of the tortilla and warm in a non-stick frying pan (without oil) for 30 seconds on each side, or until soft. Divide the black bean and chipotle sweet potato mixture between the corn tortillas (8 for two people, 16 for four). Using a spoon, place the mixture in a line along one end of each tortilla, then roll them up tightly and secure the ends with a toothpick to hold the rolled shape.
steps.label: Warm tortillas and roll taquitos
steps.notes: Microwave tortillas for 30 seconds or warm in a pan to make them pliable. Secure rolled tortillas with toothpicks.

steps.raw_text: Shallow frying: Place a large frying pan over medium-low heat and drizzle in a generous amount of neutral oil. Once the pan is hot, add the taquitos seam side down - you may need to work in batches to not overcrowd the pan. Cook for a few minutes without moving them to ensure the seam seals, then roll them occasionally to cook all sides until golden brown. Set aside on a plate lined with kitchen towel to remove any excess oil. Remove the toothpicks one cooled a little. Baking: Place the taquitos on a baking tray seam side down and spray or brush the tops with oil. Place in your pre-heated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the shells are crispy. Remove the toothpicks one cooled a little.
steps.label: Cook the taquitos until crispy
steps.notes: Bake for 15-20 minutes (midpoint 18 mins) or shallow fry until golden brown. Remove toothpicks once slightly cooled.

steps.raw_text: To make the salsa fresca, finely chop the cherry tomatoes and red onion . If it’s a large onion, half for two people will work well. Squeeze over half of the lime and season with salt and pepper. Mix well to combine. Finely slice the baby gem lettuce , and cut the remaining half of a lime into wedges and set aside.
steps.label: Prepare salsa fresca and lettuce
steps.notes: Finely chop tomatoes and onion, mix with lime juice, slice lettuce, and cut remaining lime into wedges.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the sliced baby gem lettuce between serving plates and place the crispy taquitos on top. Spoon over the salsa fresca , drizzle with cashew 'feta' crema , and serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve the taquitos
steps.notes: Layer lettuce, taquitos, salsa fresca, and cashew crema on plates, then serve with lime wedges.

title: Spicy Mushroom & Tempeh Laab With Baby Gem Wraps, Vermicelli & Satay Sauce
Crispy Tofu Katsu Curry With Sticky Rice & Seasonal Mixed Leaves In Sweet Miso Dressing

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out two saucepans and a frying pan.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and gather two saucepans and a frying pan.

steps.raw_text: Place thesushi ricein a small saucepan and pour over 2.5 times its volume of hot water from the kettle. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until tender but still slightly al dente. Keep the lid on to let it steam once cooked.
steps.label: Cook the sushi rice
steps.notes: Cook for 8-10 minutes (midpoint 9 minutes) until tender but al dente, then keep covered to steam.

steps.raw_text: Place your other saucepan over medium-low heat, add thekatsu curry sauce, and warm until piping hot.
steps.label: Warm the katsu curry sauce
steps.notes: Warm over medium-low heat until piping hot.

steps.raw_text: Take out two large bowls. In one bowl, add thekatsu batter mixand measure out 40ml of plant milk (or 80ml for a 4-person portion). If you don’t have milk, water will work too. Slowly add the liquid, stirring until you have a thick batter. Season well with salt and pepper, and mix thoroughly until combined.In the second bowl, add thepanko breadcrumbsand season with salt and pepper. Cut thetofuinto four equal slices lengthwise, and pat each piece dry with kitchen towel. Coat the tofu in the batter, then dredge in the panko, pressing gently so all sides are evenly covered.
steps.label: Prepare and coat the tofu
steps.notes: Prepare the batter and panko bowls, slice and dry the tofu, then coat thoroughly.

steps.raw_text: Add about 1 cm of neutral oil to the frying pan and place over medium-low heat. (You can use just a drizzle of oil if you prefer, but the tofu won’t get as crispy.) When the oil is hot enough to sizzle when a small amount of panko is dropped in, carefully place the coatedtofuin the pan. Turn as each side becomes golden and crispy, cooking for around 5 minutes in total. Remove and place on kitchen paper to drain any excess oil, then cut each piece into 2cm-thick slices.
steps.label: Fry and slice the tofu
steps.notes: Fry for around 5 minutes in total until golden and crispy, drain on kitchen paper, and slice into 2cm pieces.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide thesushi ricebetween serving bowls and spoon over thekatsu curry sauce. Top with thetofu katsuand serve alongside themixed leaf saladtossed inmiso vinaigrette. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve the dish
steps.notes: Assemble the rice, curry sauce, and tofu katsu, then serve with the dressed mixed leaf salad.

title: Crispy Tofu Katsu Nuggets With Brown Rice & Seasonal Mixed Leaves In Sweet Miso Dressing

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out two bowls, one roasting tray and two saucepans. Line the roasting tray with a sheet of parchment paper.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan). Prepare bowls, saucepans, and line the roasting tray.

steps.raw_text: Fill one saucepan with boiling water from the kettle, place it over a medium-high heat and bring it back to a rolling boil.Add thebrown riceand cook uncovered for 18–20 minutes, until tender with a slight bite. Drain through a fine sieve, then return the rice to the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to steam until you're ready to serve.
steps.label: Cook and steam brown rice
steps.notes: Cook rice for 18–20 minutes (midpoint 19), drain, then cover and steam until serving.

steps.raw_text: Tear thesmoked tofuinto bite-sized chunks (around 16 pieces in total).In one bowl, combine thekatsu batter mixwith 50–70ml water (double the amount for a 4-person portion) and whisk until smooth. The batter should be similar in consistency to thick mayonnaise.Place thepanko breadcrumbsinto the second bowl.Dip each piece of tofu into the batter, then coat evenly in the panko breadcrumbs. Arrange the coated tofu on the lined baking tray in a single layer, ensuring the pieces do not overlap.Drizzle or spray generously with a neutral cooking oil and bake for 15–18 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden and crisp.Alternatively, you can use an airfrier to cook the nuggets. Lightly spray or drizzle the coated tofu with a neutral cooking oil. Arrange the pieces in the air fryer basket in a single layer, leaving a little space between each piece (cook in batches if necessary).Air fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes, turning the tofu halfway through.
steps.label: Prepare and bake tofu nuggets
steps.notes: Bake for 15–18 minutes (midpoint 16.5) turning halfway, or air fry at 200°C for 10–12 minutes (midpoint 11).

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, place the second saucepan over a medium heat and add thekatsu curry sauce. Heat gently until piping hot, stirring occasionally. If the sauce begins to stick, add a splash of water. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Heat the katsu curry sauce
steps.notes: Heat gently until piping hot, stirring occasionally. Add water if sticking.

steps.raw_text: Divide thebrown ricebetween serving bowls and spoon over thekatsu curry sauce. Top with thecrispy tofu nuggetsand sprinkle over thesesame garnish. Serve alongside themixed leaf saladdressed with themiso vinaigrette. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve katsu nuggets
steps.notes: Assemble rice, sauce, tofu, sesame garnish, and serve with dressed mixed leaves.

title: Crispy Tofu 'Parm' Over Creamy Tomato Beans With Garlic Basil Gremolata, Roasted Tenderstem Broccoli & Cherry Tomatoes

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan, and take out a roasting tray, a saucepan, and a frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C (or 180°C fan) and set out the required pans.

steps.raw_text: Place the cherry tomatoes and tenderstem broccoli on a baking tray and drizzle with good-quality olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, then roast for 10–15 minutes, until the tomatoes begin to burst and the tenderstem broccoli is lightly charred.
steps.label: Roast broccoli and tomatoes
steps.notes: Roast for 10–15 minutes until tomatoes begin to burst and broccoli is lightly charred.

steps.raw_text: Take out two large bowls. Place the tofu parm batter mix into one bowl and measure out 50 ml (or 100 ml for a 4-person portion) of plant milk (or water if you don’t have milk). Slowly add the liquid, stirring until you have a thick batter. Season well with salt and pepper and mix until fully combined. Pour the panko breadcrumbs into the second bowl and season with salt and pepper. Cut the tofu in half lengthwise, then in half again so you have four thin, steak-like slices. Pat each piece dry with kitchen towel, coat in the batter, then toss in the panko, pressing gently to ensure the breadcrumbs evenly cover all sides.
steps.label: Batter and bread tofu
steps.notes: Cut tofu into four thin slices, pat dry, coat in batter, and toss in seasoned panko.

steps.raw_text: Add about 1 cm of neutral oil to a frying pan and place it over a medium-low heat. (You can use just a drizzle of oil if you prefer, but the tofu won’t be quite as crispy.) Once the oil is hot enough to sizzle when a small amount of panko is added, carefully place the coated tofu into the pan. Fry, turning as each side becomes crispy, until all sides are golden, about 5 minutes total. Remove from the pan and place on kitchen paper to drain any excess oil.
steps.label: Fry the breaded tofu
steps.notes: Fry in 1 cm of oil over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes total until golden and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Place the saucepan over a medium heat. Add the tin of butter beans , along with half of the liquid and the creamy tomato sauce , then simmer for 4–5 minutes.
steps.label: Simmer beans and sauce
steps.notes: Simmer butter beans, half of their liquid, and tomato sauce for 4–5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the creamy tomato sauce and butter beans between bowls and top with the roasted tenderstem broccoli and cherry tomatoes . Slice the crispy tofu into 1.5 cm pieces and place over the sauce. Drizzle with the garlic basil gremolata . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve
steps.notes: Slice tofu into 1.5 cm pieces, plate over beans and sauce, top with roasted veg, and drizzle with gremolata.

title: Curried Squash Noodle Soup With Rice Noodles, Crispy Coconut Chickpeas & Fresh Green Kale

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a large frying pan and two saucepans.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set out one large frying pan and two saucepans.

steps.raw_text: Add about a tablespoon of olive oil or coconut oil to a large frying pan on a medium heat. Drain and pat dry the chickpeas, then add them to your frying pan with a little salt and pepper. Cook for about 4 minutes, shaking the pan now and then. Add a splash of soy sauce if you have some, then add the sesame coconut mix and cook for another 2-3 minutes until crispy.
steps.label: Cook and crisp chickpeas
steps.notes: Cook chickpeas for about 4 minutes, then add sesame coconut mix and cook for 2-3 minutes until crispy.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over a medium heat, pour boiling water into the pan from your kettle and add the flat rice noodles . Cook for 5 minutes or until al dente, then drain the noodles. Rinse the noodles a little to stop them sticking together.
steps.label: Cook and drain rice noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes or until al dente, then drain and rinse.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, tear the leaves off the kale stalks and give them a wash. Add the curried squash soup to your other saucepan along with 200ml of water and add the kale leaves to the pan too. Cook until piping hot and the kale is wilted, around 5-8 minutes.

title: Festive Bourguignon Pie Over Creamy Mash With Caramelised Onion Red Wine Gravy

steps.raw_text: Please note: as this meal kit is a one off Christmas special, the recipe takes a little longer to cook than our usual weekly meal kits as the pie needs more time in the oven. We wanted to offer something different and special for Christmas so we hope you'll forgive us :) Boil your kettle, then take out a large saucepan, small saucepan and roasting tray. Preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan. Make up a small bowl of 'egg wash' of your choice - we recommend a mix of equal parts plant-based milk, agave/maple syrup and olive oil as a good choice!
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare egg wash
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prepare egg wash in a small bowl.

steps.raw_text: We've included enough pastry in your kit to either make one big pie in your own pie dish at home or to make two individual pies using the foil pie tins included in your kit. To make one bigger pie, follow the instructions below within this step. If you'd prefer to make individual pies please proceed to
steps.label: Choose pie size option
steps.notes: Decide whether to make one large pie or two individual pies.

steps.raw_text: . To make one bigger pie, simply empty the bourguignon sauce into a 15-20cm diameter oven dish. Unroll and lay the pastry over the top, cut off any excess and tuck the pastry up around the sides to seal. Proceed to
steps.label: Assemble large pie
steps.notes: For one large pie: empty sauce into a 15-20cm diameter oven dish and cover with pastry.

steps.raw_text: for baking instructions. STEP 3 To make individual pies, first brush the foil pie cases all over with a little oil or vegan butter so the pies are easier to remove after cooking. Roll out the vegan puff pastry onto a board with the baking paper facing your board. Working from the top corner of your pastry (so you don't run out of pastry for the lids), cut 2 x 16cm rounds out of the pastry. Lay the rounds in the foil pie tins and smooth evenly, allowing any excess to hang over the side. Next add the bourguignon pie mix into each pie tin, trying not to fill any higher than 0.5cm above the top of your pie tin. Brush the edges of the pastry with your 'egg wash'. Cut 2 x 11cm rounds out of the remaining pastry for your lids. Lay each round over each pie and seal the edges with a fork. Brush your pie tops with your 'egg wash'. Place onto a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Oven temperatures vary so check regularly to ensure they don't burn. STEP 4 Brush the pastry with your 'egg wash', then pierce the centre of the pie in an 'x' shape with a sharp knife or snip with a pair of scissors to allow excess steam out during cooking. Place onto a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Oven temperatures vary so check regularly to ensure they don't burn.
steps.label: Assemble and bake pies
steps.notes: Assemble individual pies or finish large pie, then bake for 30 minutes until golden brown. Check regularly to prevent burning.

steps.raw_text: Peel the potatoes , then cut into 2cm cubes. Once you have 15 minutes left of cooking time on your pies, fill your large saucepan with boiling water from your kettle, salt well, then place over a medium heat. Add the potatoes to the water and cook for around 10-12 minutes or until the potato is soft. It should virtually crumble when you jab it with a fork. Once the potatoes are cooked, add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, then mash until smooth and creamy. You could also add a little plant milk and butter to make it more creamy and indulgent (optional). Season well with salt and pepper to taste.
steps.label: Prep, boil, and mash potatoes
steps.notes: Start when 15 minutes of pie baking remains. Boil potatoes for 10-12 minutes until soft, then mash with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

steps.raw_text: Once you have 5 minutes cooking time left on the pies and potatoes, pour the red wine gravy into your small saucepan and place over a medium heat. We have provided quite a thick gravy so you can thin it out to your desired consistency simply by adding a little water as you cook. Cook until heated through, around 2-3 minutes.
steps.label: Heat red wine gravy
steps.notes: Start when 5 minutes of cooking remains on pies and potatoes. Heat for 2-3 minutes; thin with water if desired.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the mash between serving plates, place your pies alongside and then pour the caramelised onion red wine gravy over the top of everything. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve
steps.notes: Divide mash between plates, place pies alongside, and pour gravy over top.

steps.raw_text: Take out a frying pan (cast iron works best for charring the broccoli if you have one!) and two saucepans.
steps.label: Gather frying pan and saucepans
steps.notes: A cast iron frying pan is recommended for charring the broccoli.

steps.raw_text: Slice the tofu lengthways into four slices (you can slice the tofu in half and then those slices in half again to make them equal. Place them into your saucepan, cover with cold water and add salt. Bring the water to a gentle simmer and continue cooking for 15 minutes. This technique of cooking tofu draws water out more evenly and tightens the protein bonds for better texture.
steps.label: Slice and simmer the tofu
steps.notes: Simmer gently for 15 minutes to draw out water and tighten protein bonds.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, add the jasmine rice to your smaller saucepan and cover with 2x its volume in water. Place over a medium-high heat, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid and cook until fluffy, around 8 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a high heat and add a drizzle of oil. While it heats up, cut the broccoli into even florets, around 3cm cubed. Fry in the pan until charred on the outside and tender (but still with some bite) in the centre, around 5-8 minutes. In the final 2 to 3 minutes, add the edamame . Season well with salt and pepper and a squeeze of half a lime and cut the remaining half into two wedges to set aside for later. Remove from the pan and set aside, and wipe the pan clean with some kitchen towel.
steps.label: Char broccoli and edamame
steps.notes: Fry broccoli for 5-8 minutes (midpoint used). Add edamame in the final 2-3 minutes. Wipe pan clean after.

steps.raw_text: Give the soy garlic dressing a good shake while the pouch is sealed (in case the cornstarch has separated while sitting in the fridge) then empty it into a small bowl. When the tofu, rice and vegetables are all ready to serve, heat the sauce in your frying pan for 1 to 2 minutes or until it's hot and has thickened up a little. Be careful not to cook it too high or long, or it could reduce too much.
steps.label: Prepare and heat the glaze

Place them in a bowl with the crispy chickpea spice mix (spice warning – use half if you don’t like too much heat!) and a couple of tablespoons of olive oil, then mix well. Cut the sweet potato into roughly 2cm cubes – the smaller you cut them, the faster they will cook.
steps.label: Prep chickpeas and sweet potato
steps.notes: Drain and dry chickpeas thoroughly. Mix with spices and oil. Cut sweet potato into 2cm cubes.

steps.raw_text: Lay the chickpeas out on one baking tray and the sweet potato on another. Toss the sweet potato with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20–30 minutes, tossing everything halfway through. If you’re in a rush, they’ll be ready after 20 minutes, but if you have time, roasting for 30 minutes will make the chickpeas crunchier. Alternatively, you can air fry them for 10–15 minutes. Taste the chickpeas when they come out of the oven and season with extra salt if needed.
steps.label: Roast chickpeas and sweet potato
steps.notes: Roast for 20–30 minutes (midpoint 25 mins), tossing halfway. Alternatively, air fry for 10–15 minutes.

steps.raw_text: When there's around 5 minutes left on the chickpeas and sweet potato, drain and rinse the lentils and add these to your saucepan along with the thai red curry soup and 100ml of water. Place over a medium heat and simmer gently until piping hot, around 3-5 minutes. Stir through the roasted sweet potato once it's ready. Meanwhile, pick and roughly chop the coriander leaves.
steps.label: Simmer soup and chop coriander
steps.notes: Start when 5 minutes remain on roasting. Simmer soup for 3–5 minutes (midpoint 4 mins). Stir in sweet potato once roasted.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the soup between serving bowls and top with the crispy chickpeas , fresh coriander and pickled red onion . Enjoy!
steps.label: Portion soup and garnish
steps.notes: Divide soup into bowls. Top with crispy chickpeas, fresh coriander, and pickled red onion.

title: Hispi Cabbage Gratin In Creamy Cashew Sauce With Garlic & Herb Tempeh 'Pancetta' Pangrattato

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a frying pan and a wide casserole dish with a lid (or an ovenproof dish / roasting tray and some tin foil).
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
equipment: wide casserole dish with a lid
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan). Prepare the frying pan and roasting dish.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Cut the hispi cabbage into quarters, keeping the core intact so the leaves stay together. Once the pan is hot, sear the wedges cut-side down for about 5 minutes, or until nicely charred. Season well with salt and pepper, then transfer the wedges to a roasting dish and cover with a lid or tin foil. Roast for 10–15 minutes, or until tender. If you prefer a softer texture, add a splash of water to the dish to help the cabbage steam.
steps.label: Sear and roast hispi cabbage
steps.notes: Sear cabbage wedges for 5 minutes until charred, then roast covered for 10-15 minutes. Optionally add a splash of water to steam.

steps.raw_text: Clean the frying pan you used for the hispi cabbage, then place it back over medium heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Grate the garlic cloves and add them to the pan along with the panko breadcrumbs . Cook until golden, then remove from the pan and set aside. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop them, then combine them in a small bowl with the garlic breadcrumbs once ready.
steps.label: Make garlic and herb breadcrumbs
steps.notes: Clean the pan used for cabbage first. Cook breadcrumbs until golden, then mix with chopped parsley.

steps.raw_text: Finely dice the tempeh into small 5mm cubes. Place the frying pan back over medium-high to high heat and add a generous drizzle of olive oil. Add the tempeh cubes and fry for around 7-10 minutes or until golden and crispy, making sure they are well spread out and stirred occasionally. Once crispy, add the tempeh ‘pancetta’ marinade , stir to coat all the pieces evenly, and turn off the heat.
steps.label: Fry and marinate tempeh cubes
steps.notes: Dice tempeh into 5mm cubes. Fry for 7-10 minutes until crispy, then stir in marinade off heat.

steps.raw_text: When there are 5 minutes left on the hispi cabbage, remove the cover and pour the creamy gratin sauce around the cabbage wedges. Return to the oven and cook until the sauce is piping hot and the cabbage is tender and golden.
steps.label: Add gratin sauce and bake
steps.notes: Pour sauce around cabbage with 5 minutes left of roasting. Bake uncovered until hot and golden.

steps.raw_text: To serve, you can either scatter the tempeh 'pancetta' and herby breadcrumbs over the hispi cabbage in your oven dish and place in the middle of the table to serve 'feasting style' or you could divide the saucy hispi cabbage between serving bowls and then add the garnish. Enjoy!
steps.label: Garnish and serve cabbage gratin
steps.notes: Scatter tempeh and breadcrumbs over cabbage. Serve family-style or in individual bowls.

title: Honest Toil Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1L – Cold Pressed & Unfiltered
Hot 'Honey' Labneh Mezze With Minted Courgettes, Roasted Cherry Tomatoes, Chickpeas & Freshly Baked Garlic Flatbread

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out two baking sheets, a small sauce pan, and a large cast iron griddle pan or a frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Drain the chickpeas and pat them dry with kitchen towels. Place them on one of your baking sheets along with the cherry tomatoes , then drizzle with good-quality olive oil. Season with salt and pepper, and roast for 10–15 minutes, until the tomatoes begin to burst and the chickpeas are golden and crispy. In the last 5 minutes of cooking, place the garlic and herb flatbreads on a separate baking sheet and warm them in the oven.
steps.label: Roast chickpeas, tomatoes, and flatbreads
steps.notes: Roast chickpeas and tomatoes for 10-15 minutes (midpoint 12.5 rounded to 13). Warm flatbreads in the oven during the last 5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Using a sharp knife, trim the top and end of the courgette , then slice it vertically into long, thin strips about 2 mm thick. You could also use a wide vegetable peeler or a mandolin for this process.
steps.label: Slice the courgette
steps.notes: Slice vertically into long, thin strips about 2 mm thick.

steps.raw_text: Place your cast iron griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat and add a generous drizzle of olive oil. Once the pan is searing hot, add the sliced courgette . Sprinkle over salt and black pepper to taste and cook for 3-5 minutes on each side, until slightly charred. Once cooked, transfer to a large bowl and toss with the lemon mint pesto .
steps.label: Griddle courgette and toss with pesto
steps.notes: Cook for 3-5 minutes on each side (midpoint 4 mins per side, 8 mins total) until slightly charred, then toss with lemon mint pesto.

steps.raw_text: Place a small saucepan over low heat and add the hot ‘honey’ . Cook gently for 1–2 minutes, until warmed through. Alternatively, place the hot ‘honey’ in a small bowl and microwave on low in 30-second increments until warmed through, stirring between each interval. Stir well before serving.
steps.label: Warm the hot honey
steps.notes: Cook gently for 1-2 minutes (midpoint 1.5 rounded to 2) in a saucepan, or microwave in 30-second increments.

steps.raw_text: To serve, spread the mezze labneh onto a large plate, using the back of a spoon to create a circular indentation in the centre. Arrange the minted courgette slices, roasted cherry tomatoes and chickpeas on top, then drizzle over the ‘hot’ honey . Finish with warm flatbreads on the side and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve the mezze
steps.notes: Spread labneh, arrange toppings, drizzle honey, and serve with warm flatbreads.

title: Hot 'Honey' Labneh Mezze With Smoky Grilled Aubergine, Roasted Cherry Tomatoes, Crispy Chickpeas & Freshly Baked Garlic Flatbread

steps.raw_text: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Take out two large roasting trays. You'll want enough space to lay the aubergine slices in a single layer, with the cherry tomatoes and chickpeas on the second tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare roasting trays
steps.notes: Preheat to 220°C or 200°C fan. Prepare two large roasting trays.

steps.raw_text: Slice the aubergine into rounds, approximately 8mm thick, and arrange them in a single layer on one of the roasting trays. Drizzle generously with olive oil and season well with salt and black pepper. Place in the oven and roast for 20 minutes.
steps.label: Slice, season, and roast the aubergine
steps.notes: Slice aubergine into 8mm rounds. Roast for 20 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, drain and rinse the chickpeas , then spread them in a single layer over one half of the second roasting tray. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and arrange them cut-side down on the other half of the tray. Drizzle both the chickpeas and tomatoes with olive oil, season generously with salt and black pepper, then place the tray in the oven alongside the aubergines and roast until the tomatoes are softened and the chickpeas are crispy.
steps.label: Prepare and roast chickpeas and tomatoes
steps.notes: Roast alongside aubergines until tomatoes soften and chickpeas crisp.

steps.raw_text: When the vegetables and chickpeas are nearly ready, add the garlic & herb flatbreads to the oven and bake for 3–4 minutes, until warmed through, fluffy and lightly crispy in places.
steps.label: Bake garlic and herb flatbreads
steps.notes: Bake for 3–4 minutes when vegetables and chickpeas are nearly ready.

steps.raw_text: Spread the mezze labneh over the base of each serving plate. Top with the roasted aubergine , cherry tomatoes and crispy chickpeas , then drizzle generously with the herby zhoug and balsamic hot 'honey' . Serve with the warm garlic & herb flatbreads , and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate labneh and serve with flatbreads
steps.notes: Top labneh with roasted ingredients, zhoug, and hot honey. Serve with warm flatbreads.

title: Chaat Masala With Crispy Baby Potatoes, Tamarind Yoghurt, Minted Chilli Dressing & Crispy Sev

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan. Take out two baking trays and a small frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C or 180°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Slice the baby potatoes into thin slices, about 3mm thick. Toss them in olive oil, salt, and pepper, then spread evenly on one of the baking trays. Roast in the oven for 15 minutes, then stir in the chaat masala paste along with the drained chickpeas . Return to the oven for a further 5 minutes, or until the paste caramelises at the edges of the potatoes.
steps.label: Slice, season, and roast potatoes
steps.notes: Roast potatoes for 15 minutes, then add chickpeas and chaat masala paste and roast for 5 more minutes until edges caramelise.

steps.raw_text: Peel and finely slice the red onion . Onion sizes vary, but aim for around half a small onion per person. Dice the tomato and cucumber , then add them to a bowl along with half of the mint chutney . Season to taste and give everything a good mix.
steps.label: Prepare tomato and cucumber salad
steps.notes: Slice onion finely (aim for half a small onion per person). Mix diced tomato, cucumber, and half of the mint chutney.

steps.raw_text: Place your small frying pan over medium heat and dry-toast (without oil) the sev for 1–2 minutes, until crispy.
steps.label: Dry-toast the sev
steps.notes: Toast without oil for 1 to 2 minutes over medium heat until crispy.

steps.raw_text: Divide the chickpea and potato chaat between serving plates, top with the tomato, cucumber salad then dress with the remaining mint chutney , tamarind yoghurt , red onion , and a scattering of sev . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and dress the chaat
steps.notes: Layer potatoes and chickpeas, salad, remaining chutney, yoghurt, onion, and sev.

title: White Bean Kale Caesar Salad With Ciabatta Croutons, Caper Caesar Dressing & Happy Hormone Seed Sprinkle

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan and take out a roasting tray, a small frying pan, and a large mixing bowl.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat to 200°C or 180°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Roughly cut or tear the ciabatta into chunky croutons, around 2cm cubes. Place them on your baking tray, toss with a drizzle of olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. You can also add a grated garlic clove for extra flavour (optional). Roast until golden, about 10 minutes.
steps.label: Prep and roast ciabatta croutons
steps.notes: Roast for about 10 minutes until golden.

steps.raw_text: Remove any tough stems from the cavolo nero , then shred the leaves and place them in a mixing bowl. Add a pinch of salt and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, then massage it firmly with your hands for 2–3 minutes, or until softened and slightly wilted. Alternatively, if you prefer not to eat it raw, you can steam or boil it for 5–10 minutes.
steps.label: Prep and massage cavolo nero
steps.notes: Massage for 2-3 minutes until softened, or steam/boil for 5-10 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Cut off the base of the baby gem lettuce , then slice into bite-sized pieces. Open and drain the cannellini beans .
steps.label: Prep lettuce and drain beans
steps.notes: Slice lettuce and drain cannellini beans.

steps.raw_text: Place your small frying pan over medium heat and toast the happy hormone seed sprinkle until fragrant.
steps.label: Toast happy hormone seed sprinkle
steps.notes: Toast over medium heat until fragrant.

steps.raw_text: Just before serving, add the cavolo nero , baby gem , ciabatta croutons , cannellini beans , and around two-thirds of the caesar dressing to a mixing bowl. Toss well to coat everything evenly. Divide the salad between serving bowls, drizzle over the remaining dressing, and sprinkle over the toasted happy hormone seed sprinkle . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve Caesar salad
steps.notes: Toss with 2/3 of dressing, plate, and top with remaining dressing and seeds.
