Kimchi Pancakes With Sticky Soy Portobellos, Gochujang Mayo & Pickled Cucumbers

steps.raw_text: Take out two large frying pans (ideally one non-stick!). Cut the pak choi into 1-1.5cm pieces from the tip to the base, discarding the base. Slice the spring onions , keeping the greens and whites separate. Slice the portobello mushrooms 0.5cm thick.
steps.label: Prepare pans and chop vegetables
steps.notes: Cut pak choi into 1-1.5cm pieces, slice spring onions separating greens and whites, and slice mushrooms 0.5cm thick.

steps.raw_text: Heat a large pan with a good drizzle of olive oil. Add the portobello mushrooms and spring onion (white bits) along with plenty of pepper and cook for about 5 minutes on a medium heat. Don't stir them too often as it will stop them caramelising.
steps.label: Cook mushrooms and spring onions
steps.notes: Cook for about 5 minutes on medium heat. Avoid stirring too often to allow caramelisation.

steps.raw_text: Once the portobello mushrooms have started to soften, add the pak choi and cook for another 3-4 minutes until the leaves have softened and the stems still have a little bite to them. Then add the sticky mushroom sauce to the pan and stir well to combine.
steps.label: Add pak choi and sauce
steps.notes: Cook for 3-4 minutes until leaves soften but stems retain a bite, then stir in the sticky mushroom sauce.

steps.raw_text: To make the kimchi pancakes , pour the dry mix into a large bowl and slowly add 230ml of water while whisking vigorously to avoid any lumps. Roughly chop the kimchi and add to the bowl too.
steps.label: Mix the kimchi pancake batter
steps.notes: Slowly whisk 230ml of water into the dry mix to avoid lumps, then stir in the chopped kimchi.

steps.raw_text: Heat about half a tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan. Once hot, pour half of the pancake batter , then tilt the pan in a circular motion so the batter spreads evenly around the pan (use the back of a spoon to spread it out to the edges if needed). Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side. You can slide the pancake off onto a plate or chopping board and then turn the pan upside down onto the plate to help you flip it. Repeat with the second pancake.
steps.label: Fry the kimchi pancakes
steps.notes: Cook each pancake for 2-3 minutes per side. Use a plate to help flip if needed. Repeat for the second pancake.

steps.raw_text: To serve, layer the portobello mushro oms and pak choi over one half of the pancake , and fold it over. Top with the gochujang mayo and remaining spring onion (green bits) and sesame seeds and serve with a side of pickled cucumber . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve pancakes
steps.notes: Layer mushrooms and pak choi on half of the pancake, fold, top with mayo, green spring onions, sesame seeds, and serve with pickled cucumber.

title: Kimchi Stir Fried Noodles With Crispy Tempeh Mince, Cabbage, Carrot, Spring Onions & Sesame Gochugaru Crunch

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a saucepan and a large frying pan or wok. Pour the boiling water from the kettle into the saucepan and place it over medium-high heat.
steps.label: Boil water in saucepan
steps.notes: Boil kettle first, then transfer water to saucepan over medium-high heat.

steps.raw_text: Add the udon noodles to the saucepan of boiling water and cook until al dente, about 4–5 minutes. Drain the noodles, rinse them under cold water, and set them aside in a colander to drain.
steps.label: Cook and drain udon noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles for 4-5 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.raw_text: Crumble the tempeh into small, mince-like pieces. Heat the frying pan or wok over medium-high heat, add a generous drizzle of oil, and fry the tempeh until crispy, about 6–8 minutes. Season with a dash of soy sauce, if you have some (if not, use salt), and pepper. Transfer the tempeh to a bowl, cover to keep warm, and set aside.
steps.label: Crumble and fry tempeh
steps.notes: Fry tempeh for 6-8 minutes until crispy, season, and transfer to a covered bowl to keep warm.

steps.raw_text: Peel the carrot into ribbons, cut the white cabbage into bite-sized pieces, and slice the spring onions , separating the white and green parts. Wipe the frying pan or wok clean, then return it to a high heat. Add a drizzle of olive oil, then add the carrot ribbons, white cabbage, and the white parts of the spring onions. Cook for a couple of minutes to soften. Turn the heat down to medium, pour in the kimchi noodle stir fry sauce , and add the drained udon noodles . Toss everything together until the noodles and vegetables are evenly coated in the sauce. Add a splash of water if needed to prevent burning or sticking.
steps.label: Prep vegetables and stir-fry noodles
steps.notes: Wipe pan clean before returning to high heat. Cook vegetables for a couple of minutes, then reduce to medium heat to toss with sauce and noodles.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the noodles between plates. Top with the crispy tempeh , some kimchi and the spring onion greens. Finish with a sprinkle of the sesa me gochugaru crunch . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish noodles
steps.notes: Divide noodles, top with crispy tempeh, kimchi, spring onion greens, and sesame gochugaru crunch.

title: Lahmacun Flatbread With Meaty Spiced Tofu Crumble, Tomato, Cucumber, Sumac Pickled Onion & Garlic Yoghurt

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out two mixing bowls and a baking tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Remove the tofu from the packaging and squeeze out as much water as possible. Crumble it into one of the mixing bowls with your hands, add ⅔ of the lahmacun sauce and mix until well combined. Season with salt, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil.
steps.label: Prepare and season crumbled tofu
steps.notes: Squeeze out as much water as possible from the tofu before crumbling.

steps.raw_text: Lay the flatbreads on the baking tray and divide the lahmacun tofu mixture evenly between them, spreading it across the top in a thin layer. Bake for 15–20 minutes, until the flatbread edges are golden and the tofu layer is crispy on top.
steps.label: Assemble and bake flatbreads

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, dice the cucumber and tomato . Pick and roughly chop the parsley leaves . Reserve half of the parsley for garnish, then combine the remaining parsley with the cucumber and tomato in your second mixing bowl. Season with salt, pepper and a drizzle of olive oil, then set aside to marinate.
steps.label: Prepare tomato and cucumber salad
steps.notes: Reserve half of the chopped parsley for garnish.

steps.raw_text: To serve, drizzle the remaining lahmacun sauce over the lahmacun flatbreads and top with the tomato and cucumber salad , pickled red onion and cabbage , a drizzle of garlic yoghurt and a scattering of fresh parsley. We like cutting it up into slices like a pizza, but you could eat it with a knife and fork or wrap it up. Enjoy!
steps.label: Garnish and serve flatbreads
steps.notes: Top with salad, pickled onion, cabbage, garlic yoghurt, and reserved parsley. Slice like a pizza if desired.

Butterbean Minestrone In A Rich & Fiery Tomato Broth With Zingy Caper Salsa Verde

title: Gut-Friendly Lemon & Chickpea Broth With Crispy Parsnip & Sweet Potato, Cavolo Nero & Salsa Verde

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 220°C fan, then take out a large roasting tray, a steamer and a saucepan.

steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C or 220°C fan and set aside the required cookware.

steps.raw_text: Cut the top and tail off the parsnip and sweet potato , then dice into small 1cm cubes. Place into your roasting tray, toss in a drizzle of olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast for 15-20 minutes or until tender and crispy.
steps.label: Prep and roast root vegetables
steps.notes: Dice parsnip and sweet potato into 1cm cubes. Roast for 15-20 minutes until tender and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Remove any hardy stems from the cavolo nero , then roughly chop the leaves into bite-sized pieces. Steam for for 5-10 minutes or until tender. If you don't have a steamer you can boil for the same time.
steps.label: Prep and steam cavolo nero
steps.notes: Steam chopped leaves for 5-10 minutes. Alternatively, boil for the same duration.

steps.raw_text: Drain the chickpeas , then empty into your large saucepan along with the lemon broth and 200ml of water. Place over a medium high heat, bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and continue to cook for 2-3 minutes or until the stew is piping hot and beans are cooked through. You can continue to reduce the broth for longer if you prefer a stronger flavour.
steps.label: Simmer chickpeas in lemon broth
steps.notes: Bring to a boil, then simmer for 2-3 minutes. Reduce longer if you prefer a stronger flavor.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the stew between serving bowls, top with the cavolo nero and roasted sweet potato and parsnips . Drizzle generously with the tangy caper salsa verde , and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve the dish
steps.notes: Divide stew into bowls, top with greens and roasted vegetables, and drizzle with salsa verde.

title: Lemon & Ginger Detox Ramen With Smoked Tofu, Udon Noodles, Cavolo Nero, Carrot & Superseed Chilli Crunch

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a large saucepan and a frying pan.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set up the large saucepan and frying pan.

steps.raw_text: Remove the tough stems from thecavolo neroand tear the leaves into bite-sized pieces.Trim and peel thecarrot, then cut it into matchsticks (julienne). Alternatively, use a vegetable peeler to create thin ribbons.Place your saucepan over a medium heat and fill it with the boiling water from the kettle. Add a few pinches of salt. Cook the cavolo nero for 2–3 minutes until bright green and just wilted, while still retaining a little bite. Using a slotted spoon, transfer it to a bowl and season lightly with salt or a dash of soy sauce.You can cook the carrot in the same water for 1–2 minutes until just tender, or leave it raw if you prefer a little extra crunch and freshness in your ramen. Season lightly with salt or a dash of soy sauce and set aside.
steps.label: Prep and cook cavolo nero and carrot
steps.notes: Cook cavolo nero for 2–3 minutes until bright green. Cook carrot in the same water for 1–2 minutes if desired, or leave raw.

steps.raw_text: Empty the saucepan and refill it with fresh boiling water. Add theudon noodlesand cook for 5–6 minutes, or until tender but still al dente.Drain and rinse the noodles under cold water to remove excess starch and prevent them from becoming sticky. Leave them in a colander to drain.
steps.label: Cook and drain udon noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles for 5–6 minutes until al dente, then rinse under cold water to prevent stickiness.

steps.raw_text: Place the saucepan back over a low heat and add theshiitake & ginger lemon brothalong with 150–200ml of water (double the quantity for 4 people). Bring to a gentle simmer.
steps.label: Simmer the broth
steps.notes: Bring the broth and 150–200ml of water to a gentle simmer.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, place your frying pan over a medium-high heat.Cut thelemonin half and slice two thin rounds for garnish. Set these aside. Place the remaining lemon halves, cut-side down, into the hot pan and cook until lightly charred, about 2–3 minutes.Squeeze the juice from the charred lemon into the simmering broth, tasting as you go to adjust the amount to your preference.
steps.label: Char lemon and season broth
steps.notes: Char lemon halves cut-side down for 2–3 minutes, then squeeze juice into the simmering broth.

steps.raw_text: Wipe the frying pan clean and return it to a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil.Slice thesmoked tofuin half horizontally, then add it to the pan. Cook for 3–5 minutes on each side until lightly golden. You could add a dash of soy sauce if you have some at the end of cooking to season and caramelise the tofu, otherwise just season with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat and slice into approximately 1.5cm-thick pieces (refer to the image above).
steps.label: Sear and slice smoked tofu
steps.notes: Cook tofu for 3–5 minutes on each side until golden, then slice into 1.5cm-thick pieces.

steps.raw_text: Just before serving, add the drainedudon noodlesto the simmering broth and warm through for 1 minute.Divide the noodles and broth between serving bowls. Top with thecavolo nero,carrotandsmoked tofu. Drizzle over thesuperspeed chilli crunchand finish with a slice oflemon. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve ramen
steps.notes: Warm noodles in the broth for 1 minute, then divide into bowls and top with cavolo nero, carrot, tofu, chilli crunch, and lemon.

title: Lemon & Poppyseed Snack Bar - 100% Raw Whole Foods
Lion's Mane Steak With Chimichurri, Crispy Baby Potatoes, Watercress & Béarnaise sauce

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out a large cast iron skillet or frying pan and two roasting trays. You will also need a tea towel and a grill press, heavy saucepan/frying pan, or a flat metal lid to press down the lion's mane mushroom steaks while searing.
steps.label: Preheat oven and gather equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan). Gather skillet, two roasting trays, tea towel, and grill press.

steps.raw_text: Cut the baby potatoes into roughly 1.5-2cm cubed pieces (cutting into halves, thirds or quarters works well, depending on potato size). Place them on one of the roasting trays, drizzle with olive oil, and season well with salt and pepper. Roast on the lower shelf of the oven for 20–25 minutes, or until golden and crispy.
steps.label: Chop and roast baby potatoes
steps.notes: Roast potatoes on the lower shelf for 20-25 minutes (midpoint of 22.5 rounded to 23 minutes) until golden and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Place your skillet or frying pan over medium-high heat and add a generous glug of olive oil, or enough to lightly coat the base of the pan. Once the skillet is hot and nearly smoking, place the whole lion's mane mushrooms stem-side down in the pan. As the grill press will become very hot during cooking, fold your tea towel into a thick, heat-resistant pad to grasp the handle of your grill press, then press down on the mushroom and cook for 4–6 minutes, until the juices have evaporated, the bottom begins to form a golden crust and the mushroom has started to flatten. You don't need to continually press for the entire cooking time - pressing periodically as the mushroom cooks works well. Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper, then flip the mushrooms and press down again firmly on the other side. Continue cooking until the mushrooms have released their juices and the liquid has evaporated completely, about 6-8 minutes. Both sides should develop a deep golden, caramelised crust. Depending on the size and moisture content of the mushrooms, the searing time may vary. Remove from the heat and transfer to the other roasting tray. *We recommend leaving the lion's mane mushrooms whole, as this helps create a juicy, meaty, steak-like texture.
steps.label: Sear lion's mane mushrooms
steps.notes: Sear 4-6 minutes on the first side, then 6-8 minutes on the second side (total midpoint of 12 minutes). Press periodically.

steps.raw_text: Place the roasting tray with searred lion's mane mushrooms in the top shelf of the oven, and bake for 10-15 minutes. If the baby potatoes are ready before the mushrooms, cover them with a sheet of aluminium foil to prevent further browning, or remove them from the oven and cover to keep warm.
steps.label: Bake mushrooms in oven
steps.notes: Bake on the top shelf for 10-15 minutes (midpoint of 12.5 rounded to 13 minutes). Cover potatoes with foil if they finish first.

steps.raw_text: You can serve the lion's mane 'steaks' whole on each plate, or slice them on a chopping board, then serve (as shown in the image). If you like, you can toss the watercress in a little chimichurri dressing , before drizzling the remainder over the steaks. Serve up the roasted baby potatoes , a handful of watercress and a dollop of béarnaise sauce on the side. Enjoy!
steps.label: Slice, dress, and plate
steps.notes: Serve steaks whole or sliced. Toss watercress in chimichurri, plate with potatoes and béarnaise.

title: Mac & Greens With Tenderstem Broccoli, Crispy Kale & Mezzi Rigatoni In A Creamy Cashew Sauce

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, preheat your oven to 180°C / 160°C fan and take out a large saucepan and a large baking tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and boil kettle
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 180°C or 160°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Remove any hardy stems from the green kale and then roughly chop the leaves. Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces, place into your roasting tray, toss in a little olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast for 10 minutes, then add the kale with a little olive oil and seasoning tossed through and roast everything for a further 5 minutes.
steps.label: Prep and roast broccoli and kale
steps.notes: Roast broccoli for 10 minutes, then add kale and roast for 5 more minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile pour boiling water from your kettle into your other saucepan and place over a high heat. Once boiling add the mezzi rigatoni and cook until al dente, around 12 minutes. Drain the pasta and set aside to keep warm.
steps.label: Boil and cook pasta
steps.notes: Cook pasta for around 12 minutes until al dente, then drain.

steps.raw_text: Place the same saucepan you used for your pasta back over a low-medium heat and pour in the cashew 'cheese' sauce . Heat through for 1-2 minutes, then remove from the heat and stir through the pasta and half of the broccoli and kale . Divide the pasta between serving bowls and garnish with the remaining broccoli and kale . Season to taste with salt and pepper, and enjoy!
steps.label: Heat sauce, combine, and plate
steps.notes: Heat sauce for 1-2 minutes. Garnish with remaining broccoli and kale.

title: Mango Cauliflower Curry With Cashews, Garden Peas, Coriander and Fluffy Basmati Rice

steps.raw_text: Cauliflower, onion, garlic, ginger, red chilli
steps.label: Prep vegetables and aromatics
steps.notes: Chop the cauliflower into bite-sized pieces, and finely chop the onion, garlic, ginger, and red chilli.

steps.raw_text: toasted cashews
steps.label: Toast the cashews
steps.notes: Toast the cashews until they are golden brown.

steps.raw_text: charred cauliflower bites

steps.notes: Cook the basmati rice until it is fluffy.

steps.raw_text: An array of warming spices are balanced with rich and creamy coconut milk, then naturally sweetened with a swirl of fresh mango . Filled with charred cauliflower bites, garden peas
steps.label: Prepare the curry and combine ingredients

steps.raw_text: served with fluffy basmati rice

steps.notes: Serve the warm curry over the fluffy basmati rice, garnished with the toasted cashews and fresh coriander.

title: Mango Crispy Rice Salad With Smacked Cucumber, Avocado, Black Beans, Toasted Cashews, Tahini & Chilli Crunch Dressing

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Boil your kettle, then take out a saucepan, a roasting tray, and a large mixing bowl. Line the roasting tray with a sheet of parchment paper.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Boil kettle and line roasting tray.

steps.raw_text: Rinse the sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Add it to a saucepan with 1.25–1.5 times its volume of cold water and, if you have time, leave it to soak for 10–15 minutes. Bring to the boil over a medium heat, then cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes without lifting the lid. Once cooked, remove from the heat and fluff the rice with a fork to release the steam. Stir through half of the chilli oil until evenly coated. Spread the rice in a thin, even layer over the lined roasting tray. For extra crispiness, you can lightly brush or spray the rice with a little oil if you have some to hand. Roast for 15–20 minutes, or until the rice is crisp and golden. Add the cashews to the tray for the final 5 minutes of cooking to toast.
steps.label: Cook, spread, and roast rice
steps.notes: Soak rice for 10-15 minutes if time permits. Cook covered for 10 minutes. Roast for 15-20 minutes, adding cashews for the final 5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Trim the ends off the baby cucumber and place it on a chopping board. Gently smash it along its length using a rolling pin or the flat side of a heavy pestle until it splits, then chop diagonally into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to the large mixing bowl and toss with the remaining chilli oil .
steps.label: Smash and chop baby cucumber
steps.notes: Smash cucumber along its length before chopping diagonally. Toss with remaining chilli oil.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, peel, stone and dice the avocado and mango into bite-sized pieces. Drain and rinse the black beans . Pick the coriander leaves from the stalks. Cut the lime into wedges and finely slice the red chilli for garnish.
steps.label: Prep avocado, mango, and garnish
steps.notes: Peel and dice avocado and mango. Drain beans, pick coriander, and slice lime and chilli.

steps.raw_text: When the crispy rice is ready, add it to the bowl with the smashed cucumber , along with the avocado , mango , black beans and coriander leaves . Toss everything together until well combined.
steps.label: Combine salad ingredients in bowl
steps.notes: Toss crispy rice, cucumber, avocado, mango, black beans, and coriander together.

steps.raw_text: Divide the crispy rice salad between serving bowls. Top with the toasted cashews , drizzle over the tahini dressing , and finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and the sliced red chilli . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish crispy rice salad
steps.notes: Divide into bowls, top with cashews, drizzle tahini, and finish with lime juice and chilli.

title: Mango & Passion Fruit Oat Pot 200g
Mango Soba Noodle Salad With Avocado, Edamame, Cashews, Pickled Radish, Toasted Seeds & Crispy Onions

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a frying pan and a saucepan. Pour the boiling water from the kettle into the saucepan and place it over a medium heat. Once the water is bubbling, boil the edamame for 2-3 minutes then remove with a slotted spoon (so you can use the same water for the noodles), drain and rinse under cold water. Add the soba noodles and cook for 5–6 minutes, or until tender but still al dente. Once cooked, drain the noodles, rinse them under cold water, and set them aside in a colander to drain thoroughly.
steps.label: Boil edamame and cook soba noodles
steps.notes: Boil edamame for 2-3 minutes, then reuse the same water to cook noodles for 5-6 minutes until al dente. Rinse both under cold water.

steps.raw_text: Remove the stem from the red chilli . Finely mince half of it and mix it with the mango soba noodle dressing in a small bowl. Thinly slice the rest of the chilli for garnish. Red chillies can vary in spiciness depending on the season, so always taste a little first to check the spiciness and decide how much you'd like to use. Add the minced chilli gradually to the dressing, tasting as you go, to make sure the heat level is just right for you!
steps.label: Prepare chilli and mix dressing
steps.notes: Mince half the chilli for the dressing and slice the rest for garnish. Taste first to adjust spiciness.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a medium heat and dry fry (without oil) the crispy onions, nuts & seeds for 2-3 minutes, tossing occasionally until lightly toasted.
steps.label: Toast onions, nuts, and seeds
steps.notes: Dry fry without oil for 2-3 minutes over medium heat, tossing occasionally until lightly toasted.

steps.raw_text: Peel and destone the avocado and mango . Cut the avocado into 2 cm chunks and slice the mango into thin strips. Roughly chop the coriander .
steps.label: Prep avocado, mango, and coriander
steps.notes: Cut avocado into 2 cm chunks, slice mango into thin strips, and roughly chop the coriander.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the soba noodles between serving bowls, then top with the avocado , mango , pickled radish , and edamame . Drizzle over the mango soba noodle dressing and give them a light toss. Sprinkle with the toasted crispy onions, nuts and seeds , then finish with the chopped coriander and red chilli slices . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve noodle salad
steps.notes: Divide noodles, top with avocado, mango, radish, and edamame. Drizzle dressing, toss lightly, and garnish with toasted onions, nuts, seeds, coriander, and sliced chilli.

title: Mapo Tofu Udon Noodles In Creamy Gochujang Sauce With Fresh Cucumber Salad & Toasted Sesame Seeds

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a saucepan and a large frying pan.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set aside the required pans to prepare for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Slice the cucumber into matchsticks, add a pinch of salt and a squeeze of half a lime , and set aside to marinate. Cut the remaining lime into wedges for garnish. Separate the white and green parts of the spring onions . Roughly chop the white parts and thinly slice the green parts.
steps.label: Prep cucumber, lime, and spring onions
steps.notes: Marinate the cucumber matchsticks with salt and lime. Keep the white and green parts of the spring onions separate.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil (sesame oil is recommended if you have some). Crumble the tofu into roughly minced pieces and add to the pan along with the white parts of the spring onion . Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until the tofu starts to turn golden. Stir in the sichuan black bean tofu sauce and cook for a further 2–3 minutes until fragrant and the tofu begins to crisp at the edges.
steps.label: Stir-fry tofu and spring onions
steps.notes: Stir-fry tofu and white spring onions for 4–5 minutes until golden, then add sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until crisp at the edges.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, add boiling water from the kettle to your saucepan and place it over medium-high heat. Once the water is bubbling, add the udon noodles and cook for 4–5 minutes, or until tender but still al dente. Once cooked, drain and rinse the noodles under cold water. This helps remove excess starch and prevents them from becoming soggy. Set aside in a colander to drain.
steps.label: Boil and drain udon noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles in boiling water for 4–5 minutes until tender but al dente, then rinse under cold water to remove excess starch.

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle again, then place the colander with the rinsed udon noodles over the sink and pour boiling water over them to warm through. Drain well, then return them to the saucepan. Place over medium heat, add the creamy gochujang sauce , and mix well while gently warming for 1–2 minutes.
steps.label: Warm noodles with gochujang sauce
steps.notes: Pour boiling water over the rinsed noodles to warm them, then toss in the saucepan with gochujang sauce over medium heat for 1–2 minutes.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the creamy gochujang udon noodles between bowls and top with the sichuan mapo tofu mince . Add the marinated cucumber on the side and garnish with the green parts of the spring onion and a wedge of lime . Sprinkle over the sesame garnish and sliced chilli or chilli flakes if you would like extra heat (optional). Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish udon bowls
steps.notes: Assemble bowls with noodles, tofu, marinated cucumber, green spring onions, lime wedges, sesame seeds, and optional chilli.

title: Massaman Tofu & Potato Curry With Toasted Flaked Almonds, Organic Cultured Yoghurt, Blistered Green Beans & Garlic Naan

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out a roasting tray, a griddle pan or frying pan, and a saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan).

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks with your hands, aiming for pieces about 1.5–2 cm in size. Cut the baby potatoes into similar-sized pieces and add them to the roasting tray. Drizzle over some oil and season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven and roast for 18–20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy at the edges.
steps.label: Prep and roast tofu and potatoes
steps.notes: Roast for 18-20 minutes (midpoint 19 minutes) until golden and crispy, plus 5 minutes prep.

steps.raw_text: Place a griddle pan or frying pan over medium heat and dry roast (without oil) the flaked almonds until golden. Remove from the pan and set aside.
steps.label: Dry roast the flaked almonds
steps.notes: Dry roast without oil until golden, then set aside.

steps.raw_text: Return the pan to medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. While it heats up, trim the green beans and cut them into bite-sized pieces (or leave them whole if you prefer), then add them to the pan. Fry until they begin to char and blister, around 6–8 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Prep and fry green beans
steps.notes: Fry for 6-8 minutes (midpoint 7 minutes) until charred and blistered, plus 3 minutes prep.

steps.raw_text: When the tofu and potatoes have 5 minutes to go, place the garlic & herb flatbreads in the oven to warm for 2–3 minutes. At the same time, place your saucepan over medium heat, add the massaman curry sauce, and warm until piping hot, about 2–3 minutes. Once the potatoes and tofu are ready, remove them from the oven, add them to the warmed sauce, and stir to combine.
steps.label: Warm flatbreads and curry sauce
steps.notes: Start when tofu and potatoes have 5 minutes left. Warm flatbreads and sauce for 2-3 minutes, then combine.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the tofu and potato massaman curry between serving bowls. Serve with the flatbreads and blistered green beans on the side. Finish with a dollop of organic soy yoghurt and a scattering of toasted flaked almonds . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the curry
steps.notes: Serve curry with flatbreads and green beans, topped with soy yoghurt and toasted almonds.

title: Middle Eastern Aubergine Flatbreads With 'Labneh', Pomegranate, Crispy Chickpeas, Garlic Tahini & Fresh Mint

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan, take out two baking trays and a frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan. Prepare two baking trays and a frying pan.

steps.raw_text: Slice the aubergine into 1cm-thick rounds and place them on one of your baking trays. Add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, sprinkle with the aubergine spice mix , and season with salt to taste. Toss to coat each piece evenly, then spread them out in a single layer. Drain, rinse, and pat dry the chickpeas , then add them to the other baking tray. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, toss to coat, and spread them out in a single layer as well. Place both trays in the oven and roast until the aubergine is soft and beginning to char, and the chickpeas are golden and crispy, about 20-25 minutes.
steps.label: Prep and roast aubergine and chickpeas
steps.notes: Roast for 20-25 minutes (midpoint 23 mins) until aubergine is soft and charred, and chickpeas are golden and crispy.

steps.raw_text: Once everything is ready, warm the flatbre ads by dry frying (without oil) in your frying pan on both sides for 30-60 seconds or until lightly toasted. You can alternatively bake or grill them in the oven until warmed through.
steps.label: Warm the flatbreads
steps.notes: Dry fry for 30-60 seconds per side, or warm in the oven.

steps.raw_text: To serve, place a warmed flatbread on each plate and spread the labneh in the centre. Top with the roasted aubergine and crispy chickpeas , then drizzle over the garlic tahini sauce . Finish with a garnish of pomegranate seeds and picked mint leaves. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish flatbreads
steps.notes: Layer with labneh, roasted vegetables, garlic tahini, pomegranate seeds, and fresh mint.

title: Miso & Ginger Summer Noodle Broth With Silken Tofu, Fresh Herbs & Chilli Crisp Drizzle
Kimchi Miso Nourish Bowl With Farro, Charred Purple Sprouting Broccoli & Pak Choi

steps.raw_text: Take out a saucepan and a large wok or frying pan.
steps.label: Get saucepan and frying pan
steps.notes: Prepare cooking vessels.

steps.raw_text: Bring a pan of lightly salted water to the boil in your saucepan, add the farro grains and cook until tender, around 15-20 minutes. Drain and set aside.
steps.label: Boil and cook farro grains
steps.notes: Cook farro for 15-20 minutes until tender, then drain and set aside.

steps.raw_text: Slice the base off the pak choi and pull apart the leaves with your hands. Cut the broccoli into bite-sized pieces. Trim the roots from the spring onions, then cut them in two where the pale green and white parts meet. Cut the whites into 4cm logs. Finely slice the greens. Keep the greens and whites separate. Dice the kimchi and finely slice the red chilli .
steps.label: Prep vegetables, kimchi, and chilli
steps.notes: Keep spring onion greens and whites separate. Slice pak choi, broccoli, onions, kimchi, and chilli.

steps.raw_text: Once the farro has been cooking for 10 minutes, place your large wok or frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil. Once hot, add the thicker spring onion logs, broccoli and pak choi and cook for around 5 minutes or until lightly charred and tender.
steps.label: Char spring onions and broccoli
steps.notes: Start this step once the farro has been cooking for 10 minutes. Cook for around 5 minutes until lightly charred.

steps.raw_text: Stir through the cooked farro , kimchi , miso dressing and peas and cook until the peas are cooked through, around 1-2 minutes.
steps.label: Stir in farro and peas
steps.notes: Cook for 1-2 minutes until the peas are cooked through.

steps.raw_text: Divide the the farro and vegetables between serving bowls, then scatter over the remaining half of finely sliced spring onions and the sliced red chilli . Enjoy!.
steps.label: Plate and garnish with chilli
steps.notes: Divide between bowls and scatter remaining spring onion greens and sliced red chilli.

title: Miso Mushroom Orzotto With Creamy Cashew 'Labneh' & Chilli Pine Nut Crumb

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out two large saucepans.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare saucepans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set up two large saucepans for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Place one of your saucepans over medium-high heat, pour in boiling water from your kettle, and add salt as you would for cooking pasta. Once the water is bubbling, add the orzo and cook for 9 minutes or until al dente. Before draining, reserve a mugful of pasta water, then drain the orzo.
steps.label: Cook and drain the orzo
steps.notes: Cook the orzo for 9 minutes or until al dente. Remember to reserve a mugful of pasta water before draining.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, finely chop the chives and set them aside. Then, thinly slice the chestnut mushrooms . Place another saucepan over medium-high heat and add a generous drizzle of olive oil. Add the sliced mushrooms and sauté for 6–8 minutes until nicely caramelised and browned at the edges. Once the mushrooms are ready, pour in the miso cream and stir occasionally to prevent sticking while warming it to a gentle simmer.
steps.label: Prep and sauté mushrooms with miso
steps.notes: Sauté the sliced mushrooms for 6–8 minutes (midpoint 7 minutes) until caramelised, then stir in the miso cream to simmer.

steps.raw_text: Stir the cooked orzo into the warmed miso cream along with the baby spinach and cook until wilted, around 2 minutes. Season to taste with salt and add a splash of reserved pasta water if the sauce needs loosening any more.
steps.label: Combine orzo, miso, and spinach
steps.notes: Cook for around 2 minutes until the spinach is wilted. Adjust consistency with the reserved pasta water if needed.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the orzotto between two plates and top with the creamy cashew labneh , plenty of cracked black pepper, the pine nut crumb , chopped chives and a final drizzle of olive oil if you like. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the orzotto
steps.notes: Divide between plates and top with cashew labneh, black pepper, pine nut crumb, chopped chives, and olive oil.

title: Cheesy Pumpkin & Cauliflower Gratin With Tender Butter Beans, Cavolo Nero & Crispy Sage

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out a frying pan and a shallow casserole or baking dish (~25-30cm diameter / 4-5cm depth). NB: If you don't have a shallow baking dish, we recommend roasting the cauliflower separately in a baking tray, heating the sauce through in a pot on the hob and then combining.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare dishes
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Prepare frying pan and baking dish.

steps.raw_text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized pieces and season with a glug of olive oil, salt, and freshly ground black pepper.
steps.label: Prep and season cauliflower
steps.notes: Cut cauliflower into bite-sized pieces and season with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

steps.raw_text: Drain the butter beans very thoroughly and add them to your ovenproof dish along with the cauliflower florets and the cheesy pumpkin sauce . Stir well so everything is mixed together. Place the dish in the oven to bake for 25-35 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the top layer of sauce and cauliflower is browning.
steps.label: Mix and bake gratin
steps.notes: Bake for 25-35 minutes (midpoint 30 minutes) until sauce thickens and top browns.

steps.raw_text: When the gratin is 10 minutes from being ready, remove the tough stems from the cavolo nero and slice the leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place your frying pan over medium heat, add a drizzle of olive oil, and sauté the kale for 5-6 minutes or until tender and with slightly crispy edges. We recommend adding a splash of water to help the kale steam a little in the pan. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then remove from the pan to keep warm STEP 6 Wipe the frying pan you used for the kale with a sheet of kitchen towel and place it back over medium heat. Pick the sage leaves off their stems and add them to the hot oil for around 20-30 seconds, until crispy and aromatic. The leaves will turn slightly translucent when ready. STEP 6 To serve, divide the gratin between serving bowls and top with the crispy sage leaves and a drizzle of the aromatic oil. Serve alongside the sautéed kale and enjoy!
steps.label: Sauté kale, fry sage, and serve
steps.notes: Start when gratin is 10 minutes from ready. Sauté kale for 5-6 minutes, fry sage for 20-30 seconds, then plate and serve.

title: Mixed Vegetable Paella With Courgette, Red Pepper, Fennel, Garden Peas, Fresh Parsley & Lemon

steps.raw_text: Take out a large frying pan and a wide pan (approx 20-30cm) with a lid to cook your paella in. You can cover with foil if you don't have a pan with a lid, but ensure you are using a wide deep pan so the paella cooks evenly. Slice the courgette into 1cm rounds and cut the fennel into wedges.
steps.label: Prepare pans and slice vegetables
steps.notes: Slice the courgette into 1cm rounds and cut the fennel into wedges.

steps.raw_text: Place your wide deep pan over a high heat. Add a drizzle of olive oil to your pan and toast the paella rice until translucent, around 1 minute. Add the paella sauce and 300ml of water to the pan and combine well with the toasted paella rice. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer on a medium heat without stirring for 15 minutes, until most of the liquid has been absorbed by the rice. If the rice looks dry when 15 minutes is up, top it up with a bit more stock / water so that there is a thin layer of moisture on top of the rice.
steps.label: Toast rice and simmer paella
steps.notes: Toast rice for 1 minute, then simmer for 15 minutes without stirring. Add more water if it looks dry at the end.

steps.raw_text: While the paella is simmering, char the courgette slices and fennel wedges in a hot and lightly oiled frying pan. Add the garden peas for the final 2-3 minutes of cooking time to warm through. Season and set aside.
steps.label: Char vegetables in frying pan
steps.notes: Char the courgette and fennel in a hot pan. Add garden peas for the final 2-3 minutes to warm through.

steps.raw_text: Once the paella has been simmering for 15 minutes, reduce the heat to the lowest setting and cover the paella dish with a tight fitting lid or a piece of kitchen foil and allow the rice to finish cooking in its steam, around 5 minutes.
steps.label: Cover and steam paella
steps.notes: Steam on the lowest heat setting for around 5 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Top the paella with your charred courgette and fennel , garden peas , a generous sprinkle of chopped parsley and a squeeze of fresh lemon . Season with sea salt and freshly cracked black pepper and enjoy!
steps.label: Garnish and serve paella
steps.notes: Top with charred vegetables, peas, chopped parsley, and fresh lemon juice. Season with sea salt and black pepper.

Mushroom Birria Tacos With Melted House Queso, Onion Salsa & Rich Dipping Consommé

steps.raw_text: Preheat the oven to 220°C/200°C fan. Take out a large roasting tray, a frying pan, and a small saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat the oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan) and gather the required pans.

steps.raw_text: Tear the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces. Peel and halve the brown onion , then thinly slice one half and finely dice the other half. Set aside the diced onion for STEP 4. Place the frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil. Once hot, add the oyster mushrooms and sliced onion in a single layer. Sauté for 6–8 minutes, until softened and beginning to caramelise. Add half of the consomme and stir well to combine. Cook for a further minute, then remove from the heat.
steps.label: Prep and sauté mushrooms and onion
steps.notes: Sauté mushrooms and sliced onion for 6–8 minutes until caramelized, then cook 1 more minute with half the consomme. Keep diced onion aside.

steps.raw_text: Place the remaining consomme in the saucepan with 100ml water (double for 4 people) and stir to combine. Dip the corn tortillas into the consomme mixture one at a time, then lay them on the roasting tray in a single layer. Divide the sautéed oyster mushrooms and onion between the tortillas, then drizzle over the house queso . Roast in the oven for 6–8 minutes, until the tortillas are crisp around the edges and the house queso is bubbling and lightly golden. *We recommend lining the roasting tray with greaseproof paper.
steps.label: Assemble and roast birria tacos
steps.notes: Roast in the oven for 6–8 minutes until tortillas are crisp and queso is bubbling. Lining the tray with greaseproof paper is recommended.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, place the saucepan containing the remaining consomme mixture over a medium heat and bring to a gentle simmer. Once hot, remove from the heat and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cut the lime in half. Cut one half into wedges and set aside for serving. Pick the coriander leaves from the stems and finely chop them. Combine with the reserved diced onion and a squeeze of juice from the remaining lime half. Season to taste with salt and pepper to make a quick salsa.
steps.label: Simmer consomme and make salsa
steps.notes: Simmer the remaining consomme mixture. Prepare the salsa by mixing chopped coriander, lime juice, and reserved diced onion.

steps.raw_text: As the birria tacos finish cooking in the oven, quickly rinse and wipe the frying pan used to sauté the mushrooms and onion. Return it to a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once the tacos are ready, remove them from the oven, fold them in half, and place them in the frying pan. Fry on both sides until crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
steps.label: Pan-fry the roasted tacos
steps.notes: Rinse the frying pan as tacos finish roasting. Fry the folded tacos for about 2 minutes per side until crispy.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the birria tacos between serving plates and top with the onion, coriander and lime salsa . Serve with the remaining lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the tacos. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve tacos
steps.notes: Top tacos with the fresh salsa and serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Crispy Mushroom Shawarma With Garlic Tahini Sauce, Pickled Radish & Fresh Mint In Soft Flatbread

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a large roasting tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare tray
steps.notes: Preheat to 220°C or 200°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Slice the portobello mushrooms 0.5cm thick.
steps.label: Slice portobello mushrooms
steps.notes: Slice the mushrooms 0.5cm thick.

steps.raw_text: Place the portobello mushrooms into your roasting tray, pour over the mushroom marinade , a generous drizzle of olive oil, some salt and pepper and give everything a good mix with your hands until the they are all thoroughly coated. Roast in the oven for 15 minutes or until tender.
steps.label: Season and roast mushrooms
steps.notes: Roast for 15 minutes or until tender.

steps.raw_text: Once the portobello mushrooms are ready, remove from the oven and place the flatbread(s) directly onto a shelf in your oven to warm through, around 1 minute. Be careful not to overcook as if they’re too crispy they won’t roll up well!
steps.label: Warm the flatbreads
steps.notes: Warm for around 1 minute. Do not overcook or they will be too crispy to roll.

steps.raw_text: Lay out your warm flatbreads , spread a layer of tahini dressing over the bottom, pile on the mushroom shawarma , radish pickle and finish with some jalapeñ o mint s alsa (very spicy!). Wrap them up and get stuck in!
steps.label: Assemble and wrap shawarma
steps.notes: Layer tahini, mushrooms, radish pickle, and jalapeño mint salsa, then wrap.

title: Sushi Bowl With Coconut Sesame Crusted Tofu, Edamame, Avocado & Gochujang Peanut Sauce

steps.raw_text: Take out a frying pan and a saucepan that you have a lid for (if you have a steamer for it too, even better!).
steps.label: Gather frying pan and saucepan
steps.notes: Ensure the saucepan has a lid; a steamer attachment is optional but helpful.

steps.raw_text: Rinse the sushi rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Add to a saucepan with 1.25~1.5x its volume of cold water and, if you have time, leave to soak for 10–15 minutes. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then cover, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes without lifting the lid. Turn off the heat and leave to steam, covered, until ready to serve.
steps.label: Rinse, soak, and cook sushi rice
steps.notes: Includes 10-15 minutes of soaking (optional), 10 minutes of cooking covered, and steaming until ready to serve.

steps.raw_text: Use a peeler to peel the carrots into ribbons. You could also grate the carrot on the biggest side of a box grater if you prefer. Dress it with a little olive oil, salt and pepper.
steps.label: Peel and dress carrot ribbons
steps.notes: Can use a peeler for ribbons or a box grater to grate. Dress with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

steps.raw_text: Heat a drizzle of oil in your frying pan and add the sesame coconut mix . Stir often and fry on a medium low heat for a few mins until toasted and golden. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then place into a small bowl. Meanwhile, slice the tofu into 6 thin slices. Wipe the frying pan clean, add a drizzle of fresh oil and fry the tofu until just crispy on both sides, for about 2-3 mins.
steps.label: Toast sesame coconut and fry tofu
steps.notes: Toast sesame coconut mix for a few minutes, then fry sliced tofu for 2-3 minutes until crispy.

steps.raw_text: When the tofu is cooked, spread a thin layer of the gochujang peanut sauce onto one side of the tofu and press it into the sesame coconut mix to create a crust on one side. Repeat with the remaining tofu . Save any remaining crumb for topping.
steps.label: Crust tofu with sesame coconut
steps.notes: Spread a thin layer of gochujang peanut sauce on one side of the tofu and press into the toasted mix.

steps.raw_text: Cut the avocado in half and scoop it out of the skin with a spoon. Slice into thin slices.
steps.label: Scoop and slice the avocado
steps.notes: Scoop out of the skin with a spoon before slicing into thin slices.

steps.raw_text: To serve, plate up the rice , edamame , carrot , avocado and crispy tofu into two bowls. Drizzle over the sauce and the remaining coconut sesame coconut mix .
steps.label: Assemble and serve sushi bowls
steps.notes: Divide rice, edamame, carrot, avocado, and tofu into two bowls, then drizzle with sauce and remaining crumbs.

One Pot Cheats Mushroom Lasagne With Beluga Lentils, Creamy Miso Bechamel & Green Kale

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a large hob- and oven-proof casserole dish or deep ovenproof pan, along with a roasting tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan).

steps.raw_text: Dice the chestnut mushrooms into 0.5-1cm cubes. Remove any tough stems from the kale and tear the leaves into bite-sized pieces.
steps.label: Prep mushrooms and kale
steps.notes: Dice mushrooms into 0.5-1cm cubes and tear kale leaves, removing tough stems.

steps.raw_text: Place your casserole dish or ovenproof pan over a medium-high heat and drizzle in some olive oil. Add the chestnut mushrooms and cook until golden brown. Drain the black lentils and add them to the pan along with the lasagne ragu sauce and 100ml water (200ml for 4 servings). Stir well and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
steps.label: Cook mushrooms and simmer ragu
steps.notes: Cook mushrooms until golden brown, then add drained lentils, ragu, and water. Bring to a gentle boil.

steps.raw_text: Break the lasagne sheets into 3–4 pieces each and stir them into the ragu, making sure they are separated and evenly distributed in the sauce. Push the pasta beneath the surface of the liquid, then cover with a lid or aluminium foil and bake in the oven for 10 minutes. Alternatively, you can prepare the ragu in a saucepan in Step 3, then transfer it to an ovenproof dish and layer with whole lasagne sheets instead of breaking them up and stirring them through the sauce. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes.
steps.label: Add pasta and bake lasagne
steps.notes: Bake covered for 10 minutes. Alternatively, layer with whole sheets in an ovenproof dish and bake for 20 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, spread the prepared kale onto a roasting tray, drizzle with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Once the lasagne has baked for 10 minutes (or 20 minutes if using whole lasagne sheets), remove it from the oven and pour over the miso bechamel . Return to the oven, uncovered, for a further 10 minutes. At the same time, place the tray of kale onto the lower oven rack and roast for around 5 minutes until crisp at the edges, keeping an eye on it to ensure it doesn’t burn. Once the miso bechamel is golden on top and the kale is crisp, remove both from the oven.
steps.label: Roast kale and finish lasagne
steps.notes: Prep kale on tray during step 4. Bake lasagne uncovered with miso bechamel for 10 minutes. Roast kale on lower rack for 5 minutes until crisp.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the lasagne and crispy kale between two plates. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve
steps.notes: Divide the lasagne and crispy kale between plates.

Oyster Mushroom Shawarma Bowl With Bulgar Tabbouleh, Hummus, Sumac Pickled Cabbage, Cherry Tomatoes & Tahini Sauce

steps.raw_text: We highly recommend using a cast iron pan or griddle to char the oyster mushrooms if you have one. If you don't a frying pan will work too. As well as this, take out a saucepan and a mixing bowl.
steps.label: Gather equipment and prepare pans
steps.notes: Cast iron pan or griddle is highly recommended for charring, but a standard frying pan works too.

steps.raw_text: Place the bulgur wheat in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook until tender but still al dente, about 6–8 minutes. Once ready, drain the bulgur wheat and lightly season with a drizzle of olive oil, a pinch of salt, and freshly ground black pepper. Set aside and keep warm.
steps.label: Cook and season bulgur wheat
steps.notes: Bring to a boil, then simmer for 6-8 minutes until tender but al dente. Drain, season, and keep warm.

steps.raw_text: To make the hummus, add 3/4 of the tahini sauce and a whole tin of chickpeas along with half of the aquafaba (the liquid in the tin) to your blender and blend until smooth. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside the rest of the tahini sauce for serving. We recommend using a blender for this process. However you could mash it with a masher or the back of a fork if you don't have one or prefer a chunkier consistency.
steps.label: Blend chickpeas and tahini for hummus
steps.notes: Blend 3/4 of the tahini, chickpeas, and half the aquafaba until smooth. Reserve remaining tahini for serving. Can mash manually if preferred.

steps.raw_text: Tear the oyster mushrooms into 1.5-2cm strips and add them to your mixing bowl along with the shawarma marinade and a good amount of salt and pepper. Give everything a good mix with your hands until the mushrooms are well coated in marinade. Thread the marinated oyster mushroom pieces onto the wooden skewers
steps.label: Prep and skewer the oyster mushrooms
steps.notes: Tear mushrooms into 1.5-2cm strips, coat thoroughly with marinade, and thread onto wooden skewers.

steps.raw_text: Place your cast iron griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat and add a generous drizzle of olive oil. Once the pan is searing hot, add the mushroom skewers. We recommend compressing the oyster mushrooms with a spatula or slotted turner so that they flatten and get crispier. Cook until crispy and blackened a little, around 5 minutes on each side. Brush the mushrooms with any remaining shawarma marinade as you cook.
steps.label: Sear and cook the mushroom skewers
steps.notes: Cook over medium-high heat in a searing hot pan. Compress with a spatula to flatten and crisp. Cook around 5 minutes per side, brushing with remaining marinade.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, slice the cherry tomatoes into halves and finely chop the parsley leaves. Stir the chopped parsley through the bulgar wheat , along with a healthy drizzle of olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Chop tomatoes and finish bulgur tabbouleh
steps.notes: Slice cherry tomatoes in half and finely chop parsley. Stir parsley, olive oil, salt, and pepper into the cooked bulgur.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the bulgur tabbouleh between serving bowls and top it with an oyster mushroom skewer each, the cherry tomatoes , sumac pickled cabbage and the hummus on the side. Drizzle with the remaining tahini sauce all over. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish the shawarma bowls
steps.notes: Divide bulgur tabbouleh, top with mushroom skewers, cherry tomatoes, sumac pickled cabbage, and hummus. Drizzle with remaining tahini sauce.

steps.raw_text: Place one of your saucepans over medium heat and pour in the boiling water from the kettle, adding a pinch of salt.
