steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and gather the required bowl, frying pan, and saucepan.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium heat and dry-toast the peanuts without oil until fragrant. Roughly chop them and set aside.
steps.label: Toast and chop peanuts
steps.notes: Dry-toast peanuts over medium heat until fragrant, then roughly chop and set aside.

steps.raw_text: Crumble the tempeh into small pieces in a bowl. Wipe clean the frying pan used for the peanuts, place it back over medium-high heat, and add a generous drizzle of cooking oil (we recommend roasted sesame oil). Add the crumbled tempeh and cook for about 6 minutes, until golden brown. Add the smoky tempeh marinade and stir well to coat all the pieces evenly. Continue cooking for a few more minutes, until fragrant and crispy at the edges.
steps.label: Crumble and cook tempeh
steps.notes: Cook crumbled tempeh for about 6 minutes until golden brown, then add marinade and cook for a few more minutes until crispy at the edges.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, fill your saucepans with boiling water from the kettle and place it over medium heat. Once the water is bubbling, add the flat rice noodles and cook for 5-6 minutes, or until al dente. Drain and rinse well under cold running water, then leave them in a colander to drain. Quickly rinse the saucepan for the next step.
steps.label: Boil and drain rice noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles in boiling water for 5-6 minutes until al dente, drain, rinse under cold water, and rinse the saucepan for the next step.

steps.raw_text: Slice the base off the pak choi , separate the leaves, and wash them thoroughly. If any leaves are very large, slice them in half lengthwise. Pour the peanut butter broth into a clean saucepan along with 200ml of water (double the amount for a four-person portion) and bring to a boil. Add the pak choi leaves, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook until tender. Squeeze in the juice of half a lime at the end and stir well. For an extra kick of flavour, zest the lime and add it to the broth.
steps.label: Prep pak choi and simmer broth
steps.notes: Simmer pak choi in the peanut butter broth until tender. Finish with lime juice and optional zest.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the flat rice noodles into large bowls and ladle over the hot peanut butter broth with pak choi . Top with the tempeh , peanuts , and a squeeze of fresh lime . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve ramen
steps.notes: Divide noodles into bowls, ladle hot broth and pak choi, then top with tempeh, peanuts, and fresh lime.

title: Peanut Butter & Raspberry Oat Pot 200g
Pip & Nut Crunchy Peanut Butter 1kg
Pip & Nut Smooth Peanut Butter 1kg
Plenish Organic Almond Barista Milk 1L
Plenish Organic Gluten-Free Oat Milk 1L
Plenish Organic Oat Barista Milk 1L
Rich Porcini Lentil Ragu Over Wholewheat Rigatoni With Savoy Cabbage & Garden Peas

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle then take out two saucepans (ideally including one that has a steamer basket to go with it), and a deep frying pan or wok.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and gather two saucepans (one with a steamer basket) and a deep frying pan or wok.

steps.raw_text: Pour boiling water from your kettle into your larger saucepan and place over medium heat. Once it's bubbling add the wholewheat rigatoni and cook until al dente, around 12 minutes. Scoop out a mug full (approx 100ml) of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
steps.label: Cook wholewheat rigatoni until al dente
steps.notes: Cook the pasta for around 12 minutes. Remember to scoop out a mug (approx 100ml) of pasta water before draining.

steps.raw_text: Place your deep frying pan or wok back over a medium heat. Meanwhile finely dice the chestnut mushrooms into approx 1cm cubes - you want to dice rather than slice to get a mince-like texture for the sauce. Add a drizzle of olive oil to your pan and fry off the mushrooms until they are browned off and tender, around 5-7 minutes.
steps.label: Dice and fry chestnut mushrooms
steps.notes: Finely dice mushrooms into 1cm cubes for a mince-like texture. Fry for 5-7 minutes until browned and tender.

steps.raw_text: Fill a little boiling water in your other saucepan and place the steamer basket over the top. While it is brought back to a boil, cut the savoy cabbage into large chunks then steam until wilted, around 10 minutes. Add the garden peas for the final 3 minutes of cooking time. If you don't have a steamer you can boil instead for the same amount of time. Season the greens well with salt and pepper and stir through some vegan butter or extra virgin olive oil (optional).
steps.label: Steam savoy cabbage and garden peas
steps.notes: Steam cabbage chunks for 10 minutes total, adding peas for the final 3 minutes. Season and optionally toss with vegan butter or olive oil.

steps.raw_text: Once the diced mushrooms are fried off, drain the lentils then add them to the pan along with the porcini ragu sauc e and cook until piping hot, for around 3-4 minutes. Once the pasta is cooked, add into the pan along with some of the reserved pasta water to loosen up the sauce a little. Stir everything well to combine. We’ve kept this recipe healthy, but you could add some vegan butter and cheese to the pasta at this point if you wanted make it more indulgent!
steps.label: Combine lentils, ragu, and pasta
steps.notes: Cook drained lentils and ragu sauce with the mushrooms for 3-4 minutes until piping hot, then stir in the cooked pasta and reserved water.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the rigatoni in porcini ragu between serving bowls and serve the savoy cabbage and garden peas alongside. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate rigatoni ragu with greens
steps.notes: Divide the rigatoni ragu between bowls and serve the steamed cabbage and peas alongside.

title: Porcini, Lentil & Red Wine Stew With Swede, Portobello Mushrooms, Rainbow Chard, Lemon Cream & Chives
Pumpkin Laksa With Crispy Oyster Mushrooms, Pak Choi, Carrots & Udon Noodles

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a large frying pan and two saucepans.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set out the required pans to prepare for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Peel the carrot into ribbons. Slice the pak choi into quarters lengthways, keeping the stem in tact if you can.
steps.label: Prep carrot and pak choi
steps.notes: Peel carrots into ribbons and quarter the pak choi lengthways, keeping the stems intact.

steps.raw_text: In a separate saucepan, add the pumpkin broth along with 200~250ml of water (or 400~500ml for a 4 Person box) and heat through until piping hot. Zest the lime into the broth at the end and season to taste with salt.
steps.label: Heat and season pumpkin broth
steps.notes: Heat broth with 200-250ml water (or 400-500ml for 4 people) until piping hot, then zest lime and season.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over medium-high heat and fill it with the boiling water from the kettle. Once the water returns to a boil, blanch the carrot ribbons for one minute, then remove them with a slotted spoon and set aside. Next, blanch the pak choi for two minutes, then remove and set aside. Add the udon noodles to the boiling water and cook for 5–6 minutes. Drain the noodles well.
steps.label: Blanch vegetables and cook noodles
steps.notes: Blanch carrots for 1 minute, pak choi for 2 minutes, and cook udon noodles for 5-6 minutes before draining.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium heat and add a drizzle of oil (use sesame oil if you have some, otherwise any oil will do). Meanwhile, tear the oyster mushrooms into strips and then add them to the pan once it's hot. Fry for 5-7 minutes or until golden and starting to crisp up. Add the mushroom spice mix along with a dash of soy sauce if you have some, if not add a pinch of salt. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, then remove from the heat. Meanwhile, finely slice the spring onion and cut the lime in half.
steps.label: Fry mushrooms and prep garnishes
steps.notes: Fry torn mushrooms for 5-7 minutes until golden, add spices/soy sauce and cook 1-2 minutes. Slice spring onion and halve lime while frying.

steps.raw_text: To assemble, divide the udon noodles between serving bowls, and pour the pumpkin broth over. Top with the carrot , mushrooms , pak choi and finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and sliced spring onions . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish laksa bowls
steps.notes: Divide noodles, pour hot broth over, top with vegetables and mushrooms, and finish with lime juice and spring onions.

title: Rainbow Poke Bowl With Miso Glazed Tofu, Pickled Carrot, Crispy Kale, Edamame, Tamari Miso Dressing & Furikake

steps.raw_text: sticky sushi rice
steps.label: Prepare sticky sushi rice
steps.notes: Cook the sushi rice until sticky to form the base of the poke bowl.

steps.raw_text: pickled carrots
steps.label: Pickle the carrots
steps.notes: Prepare the pickled carrots using the vinegar and sugar.

steps.raw_text: sesame miso glazed tofu
steps.label: Prepare sesame miso glazed tofu
steps.notes: Cook and glaze the tofu with the sesame miso mixture.

steps.raw_text: edamame beans, kale, pickled carrots and crunchy radishes
steps.label: Prepare edamame, kale, and radishes
steps.notes: Prep the edamame beans, kale, and crunchy radishes for assembly.

steps.raw_text: tangy miso drizzle and a furikake seasoning made from nori and sesame seeds
steps.label: Prepare miso drizzle and furikake seasoning
steps.notes: Mix the tangy miso drizzle and combine the nori and sesame seeds to make the furikake seasoning.

steps.raw_text: Our rainbow poke bowl is full of flavour and packed with nutrition, featuring sesame miso glazed tofu, edamame beans, kale, pickled carrots and crunchy radishes on a bed of sticky sushi rice. Served with a tangy miso drizzle and a furikake seasoning
steps.label: Assemble the rainbow poke bowl
steps.notes: Assemble the bowl by placing the glazed tofu, edamame, kale, pickled carrots, and radishes on the bed of sticky sushi rice, then top with the miso drizzle and furikake.

title: Ras El Hanout Sweet Potato & Tofu Bowl With Green Tahini & Sumac Onion Cucumber Salad
Rebel Kitchen 100% Pure Coconut Water - 330ml
Red Lentil Pasta Bake With Butter Beans, Tenderstem Broccoli & Cheesy Miso Bechamel

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and boil your kettle. Take out a saucepan, a wide oven dish, and a small baking tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and boil kettle
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Boil kettle and gather the required cookware.

steps.raw_text: Place the saucepan over medium heat and fill it with the boiling water from the kettle. Season generously with salt. Once boiling, add thered lentil pastaand cook for 6 minutes or until al dente. Reserve a mugful of pasta water, then drain and set aside.Be careful not to overcook, as the pasta will continue cooking in the oven.
steps.label: Cook red lentil pasta
steps.notes: Cook pasta for 6 minutes or until al dente. Reserve a mugful of pasta water before draining. Do not overcook.

steps.raw_text: In an oven dish, combine thetomato & red pepper sauce,butter beans(including the brine from the tin), and the cookedred lentil pasta. Once everything is well mixed and spread evenly in the dish, pour themiso bechamelover the top. Place the dish in the oven and bake for 15–20 minutes, until the sauce is bubbling and the top is golden brown.
steps.label: Assemble and bake pasta bake
steps.notes: Bake for 15–20 minutes (midpoint 17.5 rounded to 18) until bubbling and golden brown.

steps.raw_text: Cut thepurple sprouting broccoliinto bite-sized pieces and toss with a drizzle of oil, salt and pepper. Spread it out on a baking tray and place it on the bottom shelf of the oven, roasting for 10–15 minutes.Alternatively, you can add the broccoli to the pasta bake in STEP 3 and cook everything together, or boil it in lightly salted water for 5–6 minutes until al dente, using the same saucepan you used for the pasta.
steps.label: Prep and roast broccoli
steps.notes: Roast broccoli for 10–15 minutes (midpoint 12.5 rounded to 13). Alternatively, boil for 5–6 minutes or bake directly with the pasta.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide thepasta bakebetween bowls and serve with a side of roastedbroccoli. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of salt and freshly ground black pepper. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve pasta bake
steps.notes: Divide pasta bake into bowls, serve with a side of roasted broccoli, and finish with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

title: Rhubarb Blood Orange Granola Pot - Limited Edition
Blistered Cherry Tomato Orecchiette, With Borlotti, Creamy 'Burrata', Crispy Garlic & Fresh Basil

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out two saucepans. Fill one of the saucepans with boiling water from the kettle, salt it generously, and place it over medium heat.
steps.label: Boil kettle and heat saucepan water
steps.notes: Boil the kettle first to speed up heating the salted water in the saucepan over medium heat.

steps.raw_text: Add the wholewheat orecchiette pasta to the pan of boiling salted water and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes. Reserve a mugful of the cooking water, then drain the pasta.
steps.label: Cook orecchiette pasta until al dente
steps.notes: Cook for about 10 minutes. Remember to reserve a mugful of the pasta cooking water before draining.

steps.raw_text: Place the other saucepan over low heat and add a generous glug of good-quality olive oil. Peel and thinly slice the garlic cloves , then add them to the oil. Spread the slices out in an even layer and let them sizzle for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. Once ready, transfer the garlic to a small bowl along with some of the oil.
steps.label: Crisp sliced garlic in olive oil
steps.notes: Sizzle the thinly sliced garlic over low heat for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy, then transfer to a bowl with some oil.

steps.raw_text: Return the saucepan to medium-high heat with the residual garlic oil. Add the cherry tomatoes and let them cook undisturbed for 2 minutes to blister on the bottom. Stir, then cook for another 3-4 minutes or until they've softened a little. Lower the heat to medium, then add the tomato sauce and the drained, rinsed borlotti beans . Cook for around 2-3 minutes, then add the basil leaves, reserving a few for garnishing. Fold in the cooked orecchiette and use the reserved pasta cooking water to adjust the consistency as needed.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes, beans, and combine pasta
steps.notes: Blister tomatoes for 2 minutes, cook 3-4 minutes more to soften, simmer with sauce and beans for 2-3 minutes, then fold in pasta and adjust consistency with reserved water.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the blistered cherry tomato orecchiette with borlotti beans between bowls and top each with a dollop of cashew ‘burrata’ . Finish with the remaining basil leaves, a drizzle of the crispy garlic oil , and season with sea salt and black pepper to taste. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate pasta and garnish with burrata
steps.notes: Divide between bowls, top with cashew burrata, remaining basil, crispy garlic oil, sea salt, and black pepper.

title: Rich & Creamy Brothy Butter Beans With Roasted Squash, Salsa Verde, Toasted Pine Nuts & Pumpkin Seeds

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out a baking tray, a large saucepan, and a small frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and gather equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan.

steps.raw_text: Halve the butternut squash and remove the seeds using a spoon. Then cut each half into wedges about 2cm thick. Place them on the baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until the edges start to caramelise.
steps.label: Prep and roast butternut squash
steps.notes: Roast for 20 minutes or until the edges start to caramelise.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, remove the hardy stems from the curly kale and tear the leaves into bite-sized pieces.
steps.label: Prep the curly kale
steps.notes: Remove hardy stems and tear leaves into bite-sized pieces.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over a medium heat and add the butter bean broth and drained butter beans along with 100ml water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for a couple of minutes. If you’d like to cook the curly kale in the broth, add it at this stage and cook until tender. Alternatively, you can sauté the curly kale to serve as a side. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a pan over medium heat, and cook the kale until bright green and starting to crisp up at the edges. Season with salt and pepper, then set aside.
steps.label: Cook butter beans and kale
steps.notes: Simmer beans for a couple of minutes. Cook kale in broth or sauté in a separate pan until bright green and starting to crisp.

steps.raw_text: Place your small frying pan over medium heat and dry-toast (without oil) the pumpkin & pine nuts mix until slightly golden and fragrant.
steps.label: Toast pumpkin and pine nuts
steps.notes: Dry-toast without oil until slightly golden and fragrant.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the butter bean broth and curly kale between serving bowls and top with the roasted butternut squash wedges. Drizzle over the salsa verde and finish with the toasted pumpkin & pine nuts mix . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve
steps.notes: Divide broth and kale, top with squash, salsa verde, and toasted nuts.

title: Rich & Creamy Cacio E Pepe Butterbeans With Tenderstem Broccoli & Smoky Chipotle Toasted Sunflower Seeds

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a baking tray and large saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare baking tray
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan-assisted).

steps.raw_text: Place the tenderstem broccoli into your roasting tray, drizzle over a little olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 10-15 mins or until tender but still with some bite.
steps.label: Season and roast tenderstem broccoli
steps.notes: Roast for 10-15 minutes (midpoint 13) until tender but still retaining some bite.

steps.raw_text: Drain the butterbeans , then add them and the cacio e pepe sauce to your saucepan. Place over a medium heat until it begins to bubble, then cook for 5 minutes more, stirring often. After this time the beans should soften and the sauce will thicken and reduce slightly. Next add the spinach and stir through for 1-2 minutes until just wilted, then remove from the heat.
steps.label: Cook butterbeans and wilt spinach
steps.notes: Cook beans for 5 minutes after bubbling, then stir in spinach for 1-2 minutes until wilted.

steps.raw_text: Add ½ - 1 tbsp of olive oil to the chipotle sunflower seeds in a small ramekin or bowl.
steps.label: Mix chipotle sunflower seeds with oil
steps.notes: Combine the seeds with 1/2 to 1 tablespoon of olive oil.

steps.raw_text: Divide the cacio e pepe butterbeans and tenderstem broccoli between serving bowls, then drizzle the chipotle sunflower seeds over the top. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate butterbeans, broccoli, and seeds
steps.notes: Divide beans and broccoli, drizzle with the prepared seeds, and season to taste.

title: Rich & Creamy Mushroom Stroganoff With Chickpeas, Baby Spinach, Basmati Rice & Fresh Parsley
Rich & Creamy Tofu Butter 'Chicken' With Baby Spinach, Garlic Naan & Toasted Almond Flakes

steps.raw_text: Pre-heat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan, then take out a baking tray and deep frying pan or wok.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan) and prepare your cooking vessels.

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks, place into your roasting tray, toss through a drizzle of olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes, turning halfway. The tofu should be starting to turn brown and crispy on the outside.
steps.label: Prep and roast the tofu
steps.notes: Roast for 20 minutes, turning halfway. Look for brown and crispy edges.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan or wok over a medium heat and dry fry (without oil) the flaked almonds to toast. Remove and set aside. Wipe the pan clean as you'll use it again shortly.
steps.label: Toast the flaked almonds
steps.notes: Dry fry without oil until toasted, then wipe the pan clean for later use.

steps.raw_text: Once the tofu has 3 minutes left of cooking time, add the butter 'chicken' sauce to your frying pan and place over a medium heat. Add the baby spinach , stir it through the sauce and cook until wilted. Remove the tofu from the oven and, at the same time, place the garlic and herb naan into the oven to warm through. Add the tofu to the curry sauce pan and stir well to combine. Add a generous knob of vegan butter if you have some and stir through (optional). Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Cook sauce, wilt spinach, warm naan
steps.notes: Start when tofu has 3 minutes left. Warm the naan in the oven while combining the curry.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the tofu butter 'chicken' curry between serving bowls, drizzle over the yoghurt and finish with a scattering of toasted almonds . We like to finish the naan with a drizzle of olive oil and sprinkle of sea salt, but it’s also delicious as it is. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the curry
steps.notes: Garnish with yoghurt and toasted almonds. Optionally finish naan with olive oil and sea salt.

title: Rich & Creamy Tofu Tikka Masala With Blistered Green Beans, Coconut Yoghurt & Fluffy Basmati Rice

steps.raw_text: Pre-heat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a roasting tray, two saucepans and a frying pan or a griddle pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and gather pans.

steps.raw_text: Place the basmati rice into one of your saucepans and cover with 1.5x its volume in water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and leave to steam with the lid on until the rest of the dish is ready.
steps.label: Cook the basmati rice
steps.notes: Simmer for 10-12 minutes until water is absorbed, then steam with lid on.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, tear the tofu into bite-sized chunks with your hands, aiming for pieces around 1.5–2cm in size. Add them to a small bowl along with the tofu tikka spice mix, a drizzle of olive oil and a generous seasoning of salt and pepper. Mix well until the tofu is evenly coated in the spices and seasoning. Spread out on your roasting tray and roast for 20 minutes, turning halfway through cooking, until crispy and charred around the edges.
steps.label: Prep and roast the tofu
steps.notes: Roast for 20 minutes, turning halfway, until crispy and charred.

steps.raw_text: Once there's 10 minutes left on the tofu, place your frying pan or a griddle pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. While it heats up, trim the green beans and cut them into bite-sized pieces (or leave them whole if you prefer) and add to the frying pan. Fry until they starts to char and blister, around 6-8 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Trim and fry green beans
steps.notes: Start when 10 minutes remain on the tofu. Fry for 6-8 minutes until blistered.

steps.raw_text: Add the tikka sauce to your other saucepan and warm through over medium heat. Just before serving, stir the roasted tofu into the tikka sauce and turn off the heat. Drizzle the coconut yoghurt in and gently stir to create a marbled effect on the surface of the sauce.
steps.label: Warm sauce and combine tofu
steps.notes: Warm sauce, stir in roasted tofu, and drizzle coconut yoghurt.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the basmati rice and tofu tikka masala between serving bowls and serve the blistered green beans alongside. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve the dish
steps.notes: Divide rice, tofu tikka masala, and green beans into bowls.

title: Rich & Fragrant Laksa With Tofu, Pak Choi, Vermicelli Noodles, Crispy Shallots, Chilli, Coriander & Lime

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a frying pan and a saucepan.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set out the frying pan and saucepan.

steps.raw_text: Place the vermicelli noodles into a bowl, cover with boiling water from your kettle and leave to cook for around 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
steps.label: Soak and drain vermicelli noodles
steps.notes: Soak the noodles in boiling water for around 5 minutes, then drain and set aside.

steps.raw_text: Dice the tofu into approx 1.5cm cubes. Place your frying pan over a medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. Fry the tofu until golden on all sides, around 5-8 minutes. Season with a dash of soy sauce (or salt if you don't have any) and black pepper.
steps.label: Dice and fry tofu
steps.notes: Dice tofu into 1.5cm cubes. Fry for 5-8 minutes until golden on all sides, then season with soy sauce or salt and black pepper.

steps.raw_text: Slice the base off the pak choi and break apart the leaves with your hands. Pour the tofu laksa broth into your saucepan along with 200ml of water and the pak choi leaves. Cook over a medium heat until the laksa is piping hot and the pak choi is tender but still with a nice crunchy bite to it, around 4-5 minutes. Squeeze in half of the lime and stir through.
steps.label: Prep pak choi and cook broth
steps.notes: Cook over medium heat for 4-5 minutes until the pak choi is tender but crunchy. Stir in half of the lime juice.

steps.raw_text: Remove the tofu from the frying pan, then add another drizzle of oil and add the crispy smokey shallots. Fry until crispy and golden, around 1-2 minutes. Watch carefully to make sure it doesn't burn. Meanwhile finely slice the red chilli and pick the coriander leaves.
steps.label: Fry shallots and prep garnishes
steps.notes: Fry shallots for 1-2 minutes, watching closely so they do not burn. Meanwhile, slice the chilli and pick coriander leaves.

steps.raw_text: To assemble, divide the vermicelli noodles between serving bowls and ladle over the laksa broth and pak choi . Top with the tofu , red chilli and coriander leaves. Finish by squeezing over the other half of lime and spooning over the crispy shallots including any residual smokey oil if you like. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish laksa bowls
steps.notes: Divide noodles, ladle broth and pak choi, top with tofu, chilli, coriander, remaining lime juice, and crispy shallots.

title: Rich & Luxurious Black Daal Makhani With Pickled Red Onion, Coconut Yoghurt, and Garlic & Herb Flatbread

steps.raw_text: Drain the lentils and take out a large saucepan. Pour the black daal makhani sauce into your large saucepan along with the drained black lentils . Place over a medium heat and cook until piping hot, around 4-5 minutes. Stir occasionally while cooking, adding a splash of water as needed if it starts to stick. Season with salt to taste.
steps.label: Heat daal and lentils in saucepan
steps.notes: Cook for 4-5 minutes until piping hot. Stir occasionally and add a splash of water if it starts to stick. Season with salt to taste.

steps.raw_text: Warm the g arlic & herb flatbreads in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds on each side.
steps.label: Warm flatbreads in frying pan
steps.notes: Warm the garlic & herb flatbreads in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds on each side.

steps.raw_text: Roughly chop the coriander leaves.
steps.label: Roughly chop the coriander leaves
steps.notes: Chop the coriander leaves roughly to be used as a garnish.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the daal between serving bowls. Top with a dollop of coconut yoghurt , some pickled red onion , and a scattering of fresh coriander . Serve with garlic & herb flatbreads on the side. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate daal and garnish to serve
steps.notes: Divide the daal between bowls, top with coconut yoghurt, pickled red onion, and chopped coriander. Serve with the warmed flatbreads.

title: Rich & Nourishing Tuscan Ribollita With Ciabatta Croutons, Cavolo Nero & Almond Parmesan

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 200°C / 180°C fan and take out a large saucepan and a baking tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 200°C or 180°C fan and gather the saucepan and baking tray.

steps.raw_text: Roughly cut or tear the ciabatta into chunky croutons around 2cm cubed. Place in your baking tray, toss in a drizzle of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. You could also toss through a grated garlic clove for extra flavour (optional). Roast until golden, around 10 minutes.
steps.label: Prepare and roast ciabatta croutons
steps.notes: Roast the seasoned croutons for around 10 minutes until golden. Adding a grated garlic clove is optional.

steps.raw_text: Strip the cavolo nero leaves from the stems, roll them up tightly and slice very finely so they’ll cook quickly in the sauce. Add the ribollita sauce , 100ml of water and the sliced cavolo nero to your saucepan. Place over a medium heat and cook for 5 minutes. Drain the mixed beans, add to the saucepan and cook for a further 5 minutes or until the cavolo nero has wilted and the soup is piping hot. Season well with salt and pepper before serving.
steps.label: Prep and cook ribollita soup
steps.notes: Cook cavolo nero in sauce for 5 minutes, then add drained beans and cook for another 5 minutes until wilted and piping hot.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the ribollita between serving bowls and top with the ciabatta croutons and cavolo nero . Sprinkle over the almond parmesan and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish ribollita
steps.notes: Divide soup into bowls, top with croutons, cavolo nero, and sprinkle with almond parmesan.

title: Rich Pearl Barley Mushroom Risotto With Braised Cavolo Nero, Toasted Hazelnuts & Crispy Sage
Rich Porcini & Red Wine Lentil Ragu Over Creamy Mash With Crispy Oyster Mushrooms

steps.raw_text: Take out two saucepans and a frying pan.
steps.label: Gather pans and saucepans
steps.notes: Prepare two saucepans and one frying pan for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Fill one of your saucepans with water and place it over a medium high heat and bring to a boil. Peel the potatoes , then cut them into 2 cm cubes. Salt the boiling water, add the potatoes, and cook for around 10–12 minutes, or until very soft. They should almost crumble when pierced with a fork.
steps.label: Boil and cook potatoes
steps.notes: Cook potatoes for 10-12 minutes until very soft and crumbling when pierced with a fork.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil or some vegan butter, if you have it. Tear the oyster mushrooms into bite-sized pieces and add them to the pan. Fry for around 10 minutes, until golden and crispy. Season well with salt and pepper. Alternatively, if you have an air fryer, toss the oyster mushrooms in a drizzle of olive oil and cook at 180°C for 10 minutes, or until crispy.
steps.label: Fry oyster mushrooms until crispy
steps.notes: Fry for around 10 minutes. Alternatively, air fry at 180°C for 10 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Drain the lentils and add them to your other saucepan with the p orcini lentil sauce . Warm through over a low-medium heat until piping hot. Add a little water if the sauce reduces too much or starts to stick. Meanwhile, finely chop the fresh parsley .
steps.label: Warm lentils and chop parsley
steps.notes: Warm lentils over low-medium heat until piping hot. Finely chop parsley while warming.

steps.raw_text: Once the potatoes are cooked, drain the water and add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, then mash until smooth and creamy. You can also add a little plant milk or butter for extra creaminess (optional). Season well with salt and black pepper to taste.
steps.label: Drain and mash potatoes
steps.notes: Mash until smooth and creamy. Optionally add plant milk or butter for extra creaminess.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the mashed potato between serving bowls, spoon over the porcini lentils, top with your crispy oyster mushrooms and finish with a scattering of fresh parsley . You could finish with a final drizzle of extra virgin olive oil if you like. Season to taste and enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the dish
steps.notes: Layer mashed potato, lentils, crispy mushrooms, and fresh parsley. Finish with optional olive oil.

title: Saucy Harissa Lentils & Charred Aubergine Over Whipped Tahini With Sumac Pickled Onion & Fresh Parsley
Rich & Smokey Black Bean Birria Soup With Charred Corn, Avocado Crema & Crunchy Tortilla Chips
Rich Tomato & Roasted Red Pepper Soup With Grilled Cheese Croutons & Zingy Salsa Verde
Roasted Sweet Potato With Curried Chickpeas, Baby Spinach, Organic Cultured Soy Yoghurt & Pink Pickled Onions

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a large saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare saucepan
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan).

steps.raw_text: Prick the sweet potatoes all over with a paring knife or fork, then microwave them on high for 5-6 minutes, rotating halfway through (be careful as they will be hot). Place onto a baking tray, cover in olive oil, salt and pepper and then roast in the oven for 15 minutes or until soft. If you don't have a microwave you can bake the sweet potatoes from raw but they will take longer - just slice them in half lengthways, rub with olive oil, salt and pepper, and cook cut-side up until lightly browned and tender, around 30 minutes depending on the size of the sweet potato.
steps.label: Microwave and roast sweet potatoes
steps.notes: Microwave for 5-6 minutes (midpoint 5.5), then roast for 15 minutes. Total ~21 minutes. If no microwave, bake raw for 30 minutes.

steps.raw_text: To make the curried chickpeas, simply drain the chickpeas , then add them to your saucepan along with the chickpea curry sauce and simmer on low for 5 minutes. Then add the baby spinach and stir until wilted.
steps.label: Simmer chickpeas and wilt spinach
steps.notes: Simmer chickpeas for 5 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted.

steps.raw_text: Remove the sweet potatoes from the oven and slice them open lengthways. Place a sweet potato onto each serving bowl or plate, serve the chickpea curry over the top and then garnish with soy yoghurt and some pickled red onions . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish sweet potatoes
steps.notes: Slice sweet potatoes, top with chickpea curry, soy yoghurt, and pickled onions.

title: Rotisserie Tofu Wrap With Creamy Caesar Dressing, Chopped Salad & Baby Gem In Soft Tortilla

steps.raw_text: Thinly sliced tofu
steps.label: Slice the tofu
steps.notes: Slice the tofu thinly to prepare it for cooking.

steps.raw_text: tofu that's juicy and tender on the inside and perfectly crispy on the outside
steps.label: Cook the tofu
steps.notes: Cook the sliced tofu until it is crispy on the outside while remaining tender on the inside.

steps.raw_text: crunchy baby gem, juicy cherry tomatoes and sharp red onion
steps.label: Prepare the salad vegetables
steps.notes: Chop and prepare the baby gem lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and red onion.

steps.raw_text: piled into a soft tortilla wrap with crunchy baby gem, juicy cherry tomatoes and sharp red onion, all drizzled in our best-selling tangy, creamy cashew caesar dressing.
steps.label: Assemble the wrap
steps.notes: Pile the cooked tofu and prepared vegetables into the soft tortilla wrap, then drizzle with the cashew caesar dressing.

title: Sardinian Longevity Minestrone With Fregola, Organic Mixed Beans, Cavolo Nero & Salsa Verde Dressing
Saucy Harissa & Squash Baked Beans With Melted 'Mozzarella' & Warm Dunking Ciabatta
Sesame Miso Noodles With Minted Sugar Snaps & Edamame, Cashews, Radish & Chilli Crunch Cucumber Salad

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a sauce pan, frying pan and three small bowls. Fill your saucepan with boiling water from your kettle, place over a high heat and bring to the boil for the noodles.
steps.label: Boil water in saucepan
steps.notes: Boil kettle and bring saucepan of water to a boil.

steps.raw_text: Add the sesame chilli crunch to one of your bowls, and add a tablespoon of oil (toasted sesame oil is recommended) if you'd like a looser consistency. Trim the ends of the baby cucumber , and place it on a chopping board. Smash it gently along the length using a rolling pin or a heavy pestle until it splits, then chop diagonally into bite-sized chunks. Trim and remove any stringy ends of the sugar snap peas and pick the mint leaves off the stems. Slice the sugar snap peas as finely as you can at a diagonal angle. Finely chop the mint leaves.
steps.label: Prep cucumber, sugar snaps, and mint
steps.notes: Prepare dressing, smash and chop cucumber, slice sugar snaps, and chop mint.

steps.raw_text: Blanch the edamame in your saucepan of boiling water for the noodle for a minute or two, then remove them using a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the udon noodles and cook for 5-6 minutes or until tender but al dente. Once they're ready, drain and rinse the noodles under cold water. Set them aside in a colander over the saucepan to drain. Dry fry (without oil) the cashew nuts in your frying pan for a few minutes or until toasted.
steps.label: Blanch edamame, cook noodles, toast cashews
steps.notes: Blanch edamame for 1-2 minutes, cook noodles for 5-6 minutes, and dry fry cashews for a few minutes.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, place the smacked baby cucumber in one of your bowls, drizzle over a couple of table spoons of the sesame chilli crunch dressing and stir until the cucumber is nicely coated. Season to taste with salt and set aside to marinade. In the other mixing bowl, combine the sliced sugar snap peas , edamame and mint , and add a sprinkle of salt to taste. Set aside while you prepare the rest of the dish. Cut the radish into matchsticks or finely slice.
steps.label: Dress cucumber, mix salad, slice radish
steps.notes: Dress cucumber, combine sugar snaps, edamame, and mint, and slice radish.

steps.raw_text: You can eat the noodles hot or cold. If you prefer hot noodles, pour boiling water from your kettle all over the noodles to re-heat. Add the sesame miso sauce to the udon noodles and combine well in the emptied saucepan.
steps.label: Sauce and optionally reheat noodles
steps.notes: Optionally reheat noodles with boiling water, then toss with sesame miso sauce.

steps.raw_text: Divide the udon noodles between serving bowls. Top with the minted edamame and sugarsnaps , sliced radishes and toasted cashews . Finish with a drizzle of the remaining sesame chilli crunch enjoy it alongside the smacked baby cucumber salad . Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish noodles
steps.notes: Divide noodles, top with salad, radishes, cashews, and drizzle with chilli crunch.

title: Savoy Cabbage Dumplings With Garlic Ginger Miso Brothy Rice & Umami Chilli Crisp Drizzle

steps.raw_text: Take out a large, deep frying pan or a wok with a lid, and two saucepans.
steps.label: Gather pans and saucepans
equipment: large deep frying pan or wok with lid
steps.notes: Gather a large deep frying pan or wok with a lid, and two saucepans.

steps.raw_text: Add the jasmine rice to one of the saucepans, cover with twice its volume of water, and place over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat, cover, and cook for a further 8–10 minutes, or until tender. Drain and set aside to keep warm.
steps.label: Cook jasmine rice
steps.notes: Bring to a boil, then cover and cook for 8–10 minutes until tender. Drain and keep warm.

steps.raw_text: Place your large frying pan or wok over medium-high heat, add about 2 cm of water, and bring to a boil. Separate 8–10 large whole leaves of savoy cabbage, and place them in the frying pan or wok. Put the lid on and steam until tender and slightly translucent, about 3 minutes. Carefully remove the leaves with a pair of tongs, as they will be hot, and place them on a large plate to cool. Dab away any excess moisture with kitchen towel. *You may have some excess savoy cabbage, depending on the size provided in your meal kit. You can steam the rest using the same method to serve on the side, or save it for another meal.
steps.label: Steam savoy cabbage leaves
steps.notes: Steam 8–10 cabbage leaves for about 3 minutes until tender and translucent. Cool on a plate and pat dry.

steps.raw_text: To prepare the dumpling filling, finely dice the chestnut mushrooms and chop or crush the walnuts . Drain any remaining water from the frying pan or wok used to steam the cabbage, return it to medium heat, and add a drizzle of oil. Add the mushrooms and walnuts and cook for 5–6 minutes, until the mushrooms have softened. Remove from the heat. Stir in half of the chilli crisp , combine well, and season with salt or a dash of soy sauce to taste.
steps.label: Prepare and cook dumpling filling
steps.notes: Dice mushrooms and chop walnuts. Cook in the drained pan for 5–6 minutes, then stir in half of the chilli crisp and season.

steps.raw_text: Divide the dumpling filling into 8 portions and place each portion onto a steamed cabbage leaf . Fold in the sides so they overlap the filling, then roll the leaf up tightly to create a parcel-like shape and secure with a toothpick. You could alternatively cut the leaves into 20cm circles and tie them with chives similarly to the recipe image above, but this is more technical and time consuming, so we recommend the toothpick version for ease.
steps.label: Assemble cabbage dumplings
steps.notes: Divide filling into 8 portions, roll tightly in cabbage leaves, and secure with toothpicks.

steps.raw_text: Place another saucepan over medium heat and add the miso base along with 180 ml of water. Bring to a simmer. Once hot, carefully place the dumplings into the broth to warm through. STEP 6 To serve, divide the jasmine rice between serving bowls and place the dumplings on top. Ladle over the hot miso broth and finish with a drizzle of chilli crisp and chopped chives . Enjoy!
steps.label: Simmer dumplings and serve
steps.notes: Simmer miso base with water, warm the dumplings in the broth, then plate with rice, broth, remaining chilli crisp, and chives.

title: Sesame Noodles With Crispy Tempeh Mince, Braised Cavolo Nero & Fragrant Thai Basil

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out a large saucepan and a large frying pan or wok.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare pans
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set up the cooking stations.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. While your pan heats up, crumble the tempeh into a mince. You can keep the texture rough and uneven, some big bits and some smaller will add a nice texture! Add the tempeh mince to the pan and fry until it's starting to turn golden, around 5 minutes.
steps.label: Crumble and fry tempeh mince
steps.notes: Fry the crumbled tempeh for around 5 minutes until it starts to turn golden.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, strip the leaves off the cavolo nero , roll them up tightly and finely shred. After the tempeh has had 5 minutes, add the cavolo nero to the pan and cook for a 2-3 minutes more. Add a dash of soy or salt and stir through.
steps.label: Shred and add cavolo nero
steps.notes: Shred the cavolo nero while the tempeh cooks. Cook together for 2-3 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over a medium heat, pour boiling water into the pan from your kettle and add bring to the boil. Add the flat rice noodles and cook until tender but al dente, around 3-5 minutes. Watch them carefully and try them occasionally as rice noodles can overcook easily. Once al dente, drain the noodles, and rinse well under cold water. We recommend reserving some of the cooking water for the sauce later. Toss the noodles in a drizzle of oil to stop them sticking together.
steps.label: Boil and cook rice noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles for 3-5 minutes (midpoint 4 mins) until al dente. Reserve some cooking water before draining and rinsing.

steps.raw_text: Pick the Thai basil leaves, then add these and one third of the sesame garlic sauce to the pan with the tempeh and cavolo nero . Cook for one minute, then add the cooked flat rice noodles and stir everything through for a further 30-60 seconds or until everything is cooked through and combined. Turn the pan off, then add the rest of the sesame garlic sauce and give everything a good stir. Add a little of your reserved noodle water to loosen if the sauce has reduced too much.
steps.label: Combine noodles, sauce, and basil
steps.notes: Cook basil and 1/3 sauce for 1 minute, then toss with noodles for 30-60 seconds. Off heat, stir in remaining sauce and loosen with noodle water if needed.

steps.raw_text: Divide the stir fried noodles between serving bowls. Slice the red chilli and scatter over the top along with the sesame seed garnish and enjoy!
steps.label: Garnish and serve noodles
steps.notes: Slice the red chilli and scatter over the plated noodles along with the sesame seeds.

title: Lebanese Wrap With Crispy Spiced Tofu, Sumac Pickled Onions, Green Tahini Sauce & Fresh Salad

steps.raw_text: Preheat the oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a frying pan and a mixing bowl.
steps.label: Preheat oven and gather equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan) and prepare the pan and bowl.

steps.raw_text: Using a vegetable peeler, slice the tofu into thick ribbons. Alternatively, you can use a knife. What we want to achieve here is a mixture of thin and thick parts in each of the strips, which will help create a balance of crispy and meaty textures. Place the tofu in your mixing bowl and add the tofu spice mix along with a generous drizzle of olive oil. Combine well, making sure every piece is evenly coated.
steps.label: Slice and marinate the tofu
steps.notes: Slice tofu into ribbons using a peeler or knife. Toss with spices and olive oil in the bowl.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a medium-high heat and, once hot, add the marinated tofu ribbons. Cook for 4–6 minutes until crispy around the edges. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Fry the marinated tofu ribbons
steps.notes: Cook over medium-high heat for 4–6 minutes until edges are crispy. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, pop the garlic & herb flatbreads into the oven to warm through for 3–4 minutes. Alternatively, you can warm them in a frying pan over the hob or under the grill. Slice the plum tomato and set aside. Finely slice the cabbage (use a mandoline if you have one) and add a little olive oil, salt, and pepper to taste. Massage lightly until well combined.
steps.label: Warm flatbreads and prepare salad
steps.notes: Warm flatbreads in the oven for 3–4 minutes. Slice tomato and cabbage, then massage cabbage with oil and seasoning.

steps.raw_text: To serve, lay out the warmed flatbreads and spread over the herby tahini yoghurt . Top with the seasoned cabbage , sliced tomato , and pickled red onion , then finish with the crispy Lebanese-spiced tofu . Wrap up and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve the wraps
steps.notes: Spread tahini yoghurt on flatbreads, layer with cabbage, tomato, pickled onion, and crispy tofu, then wrap.

title: Pulled Tofu Tacos In Guajillo Adobo Sauce With Guacamole & Pico De Gallo On Soft Tortillas

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a large roasting tray, saucepan and a large frying pan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C for fan ovens.

steps.raw_text: Grate the tofu using a large cheese grater (you can crumble it if you don't have one). Add the shredded tofu into your roasting tray, season generously with salt and pepper and toss in a healthy glug of olive oil. You could add some soy sauce for extra flavour if you have some (optional). Place in the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until it's starting to get crispy in some places, but not burned. It should be more dried out and not watery.
steps.label: Grate, season, and bake tofu
steps.notes: Bake for 15-20 minutes (midpoint 18) until starting to get crispy and dried out.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, finely dice half of the red onion , dice the tomato , finely chop the coriander and remove the flesh from the avocado . Place the avocado into a bowl, season well with salt and squeeze in half of the lime. Mash the avocado up with a fork until you have a smooth guacamole. Stir through a healthy drizzle of extra virgin olive oil to make it nice and glossy (optional). Place the chopped tomato into a separate bowl with half of the coriander , the diced red onion, the other half of lime juice and season well with salt and pepper. This is your pico de gallo.
steps.label: Make guacamole and pico de gallo
steps.notes: Can be prepared in parallel while the oven preheats and the tofu bakes.

steps.raw_text: Once the tofu is done in the oven, pour the guajillo adobo sauce into your saucepan and warm through over a medium-low heat. Turn it off the heat and stir through the roasted tofu.
steps.label: Warm sauce and coat tofu
steps.notes: Warm the guajillo adobo sauce over medium-low heat before stirring in the baked tofu.

steps.raw_text: Dry fry (without oil) the tortillas in your large frying pan until lightly charred and warmed through.
steps.label: Dry fry the tortillas
steps.notes: Dry fry without oil until lightly charred and warmed through.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the tortillas between serving plates and build your tacos starting with the guacamole , then shredded adobo tofu and top with the pico de gallo . Garnish with the remaining coriander and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish the tacos
steps.notes: Build tacos starting with guacamole, then adobo tofu, pico de gallo, and garnish with coriander.

title: Sichuanese Mapo Tofu With Sticky Jasmine Rice & Cavolo Nero In A Sweet Rice Vinegar Dressing

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle and take out two saucepans and a small mixing bowl.
steps.label: Boil kettle and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Boil the kettle and set out two saucepans and a small mixing bowl.

steps.raw_text: Add the jasmine rice to one of your saucepans and cover with 1.5 times its volume of water. Place over a medium-high heat and bring to the boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and leave to stand, covered, to steam before fluffing with a fork.
steps.label: Cook and steam jasmine rice
steps.notes: Bring to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes (midpoint 9 minutes) until water is absorbed. Let steam before fluffing.

steps.raw_text: Place the other saucepan over a medium heat, fill it with boiling water from the kettle, and add a few pinches of salt. Remove the tough stems from the cavolo nero and tear the leaves into bite-sized pieces. Boil for 3–5 minutes, until tender and bright green. Remove from the saucepan using a slotted spoon and place in your mixing bowl along with the sweet rice vinegar dressing . Toss well and leave to marinate.
steps.label: Prep and boil cavolo nero
steps.notes: Boil the torn cavolo nero leaves for 3–5 minutes (midpoint 4 minutes) until tender, then toss with dressing in the mixing bowl.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, dice the tofu into 1.5–2cm cubes. Once the cavolo nero has been removed from the saucepan, add the tofu and boil for 4–5 minutes. Boiling the tofu briefly helps firm its texture and allows it to absorb flavours more effectively. Drain the tofu and return it to the saucepan. Add the mapo sauce along with 100ml water (double the volume for 4 people) and place over a medium-low heat. Warm gently for 3–5 minutes, until the sauce is piping hot and the tofu has absorbed the flavours.
steps.label: Dice, boil, and simmer tofu
steps.notes: Dice tofu, boil in the same saucepan for 4–5 minutes (midpoint 4.5 minutes), drain, then simmer with mapo sauce and water for 3–5 minutes (midpoint 4 minutes).

steps.raw_text: Pick the coriander leaves from the stems and finely slice the spring onions for garnish.
steps.label: Prep coriander and spring onions
steps.notes: Pick coriander leaves and finely slice spring onions for the final garnish.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the jasmine rice between serving bowls and spoon over the mapo tofu . Garnish with the coriander leaves and sliced spring onions , and serve the marinated cavolo nero on the side. For extra spice, add freshly ground black pepper or chilli flakes if you have them to hand. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish mapo tofu
steps.notes: Assemble the bowls with rice, mapo tofu, and marinated cavolo nero. Garnish with coriander and spring onions.

title: Silken Tofu With Sweet & Spicy Mushroom Sauce Over Sushi Rice & Gochugaru Garlic Crunch
Slow-Cooked Mushroom Bourguignon Over Creamy Mash With Green Kale

steps.raw_text: Take out two saucepans and a frying pan.
steps.label: Gather saucepans and frying pan
steps.notes: Prepare the necessary cookware before starting.

steps.raw_text: Fill one of your saucepans with water and place it over a medium high heat and bring to a boil. Peel thepotatoes, then cut them into 2 cm cubes. Salt the boiling water, add the potatoes, and cook for around 10–12 minutes, or until very soft. They should almost crumble when pierced with a fork.Place thekalein the other saucepan and boil for 6–8 minutes, or until bright green and al dente. If you have a steamer, you can steam the kale instead.
steps.label: Boil potatoes and kale
steps.notes: Potatoes cook for 10-12 minutes until very soft and crumbling. Kale boils for 6-8 minutes or can be steamed.

steps.raw_text: Place the frying pan over a medium heat and add a drizzle of oil. While it heats up, thinly slice half of thechestnut mushroomsand cut the other half into quarters to add texture. Fry the mushrooms for around 10 minutes, until golden and caramelised. Add thebourguignon sauceand cook for a further 2–3 minutes, or until piping hot. Add a little water if needed, should the sauce reduce too much or start to stick. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
steps.label: Prep and fry mushrooms with sauce
steps.notes: Slice half and quarter half of the mushrooms. Fry for 10 minutes until golden, then cook with sauce for 2-3 minutes.

steps.raw_text: Once thepotatoesare cooked, drain the water and add a generous drizzle of extra virgin olive oil, then mash until smooth and creamy. You can also add a little plant milk or butter for extra creaminess (optional). Season well with salt and black pepper to taste.
steps.label: Drain and mash potatoes
steps.notes: Mash until smooth and creamy. Optional: add plant milk or butter for extra creaminess.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide themashbetween serving bowls, ladle over themushroom bourguignon, and serve alongside thekale. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve
steps.notes: Divide mash, ladle mushroom bourguignon, and serve alongside the kale.

title: Smoked Tofu Chipotle Burrito Bowl With Black Beans, Avocado, Charred Corn & Crispy Tortillas

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out a saucepan, frying pan and large roasting tray.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan. Gather saucepan, frying pan, and roasting tray.

steps.raw_text: Wash the basmati rice , then add to your saucepan along with twice its volume of water. Place over a medium-high heat and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover with a lid, and cook until fluffy, about 8 minutes.
steps.label: Wash and cook basmati rice
steps.notes: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then cover and simmer on low for about 8 minutes until fluffy.

steps.raw_text: Tear the tofu in half, then half again, and so on until you have around 16 bite-sized pieces. Cut the corn tortillas into quarters. Add the tofu to your roasting tray, drizzle with olive oil and season well with salt and pepper. Roast for 10 minutes, then toss it in ¾ of the chipotle sauce . After 10 minutes, add the tortilla quarters to the other side of your roasting tray, and add a drizzle of olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast both for a further 10 minutes, turning the tortilla chips half way. Tortillas can cook quite quickly depending how powerful your oven is, so remove them sooner if they are already crispy.
steps.label: Prep and roast tofu and tortillas
steps.notes: Roast tofu for 10 minutes, toss in 3/4 chipotle sauce, add tortillas, and roast both for another 10 minutes. Watch tortillas closely as they cook quickly.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over a high heat and add a little more oil. Drain the tin of sweetcorn and add it to the hot pan. Cook until the corn starts to char, about 4–5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper, then remove from the pan into a bowl and cover to keep warm. Reduce the heat to medium, then add the drained black beans to your frying pan, along with the remaining ¼ of the chipotle sauce . Gently warm for 3-4 minutes and season to taste with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat and cover to keep warm.
steps.label: Char corn and warm black beans
steps.notes: Char sweetcorn for 4-5 minutes, transfer to a bowl, then warm black beans with remaining chipotle sauce for 3-4 minutes.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime peel, halve and de-stone the avocado . You can either thinly slice each half or turn it into a quick guacamole, by adding the lime, salt, pepper and a little olive oil.
steps.label: Prepare avocado or quick guacamole
steps.notes: Peel, halve, and de-stone the avocado. Either slice it or mash with lime, salt, pepper, and olive oil for guacamole.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the basmati rice between serving bowls and top with the s moky chipotle tofu , black beans , charred sweetcorn and avocado. Finish with a drizzle of lime crema and enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve burrito bowls
steps.notes: Divide rice among bowls, top with tofu, beans, corn, and avocado, then finish with a drizzle of lime crema.

title: Smoky Pumpkin Soup With Creamy White Beans, Crispy Sage, Urfa Chilli Seeds & Organic Ciabatta
Sweet & Smoky Butter Bean Shakshuka With Whipped Tahini, Toasted Dukkah & Soft Garlic Flatbread

steps.raw_text: All you need for this dish is two large frying pans. De-stem the red pepper and cut into 1cm slices.
steps.label: De-stem and slice red pepper
steps.notes: Cut the de-stemmed pepper into 1cm slices.

steps.raw_text: Place your large frying pan over a medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil. Once hot, add the sliced peppers and fry until lightly charred on the outside and starting to go tender. Reduce the heat to medium and add the shakshuka sauce along with the tin of drained butter beans . Cook for 4-5 minutes or until piping hot, adding water as needed if it reduces too much or starts to stick.
steps.label: Fry peppers and cook shakshuka
steps.notes: Fry peppers until lightly charred, then add sauce and beans and cook for 4-5 minutes. Add water if sticking.

steps.raw_text: Warm the flatbre ads by dry frying (without oil) in your other frying pan on both sides for 30-60 seconds or until lightly toasted. You can alternatively bake or grill them in the oven until warmed through.
steps.label: Warm the flatbreads
steps.notes: Dry fry for 30-60 seconds per side, or warm in the oven.

steps.raw_text: Pick the parsley leaves, then finely chop.
steps.label: Pick and chop parsley
steps.notes: Finely chop the picked parsley leaves.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the shakshuka between serving bowls, drizzle over the whipped tahini , and scatter over the dukkah and fresh parsley . Use your warm flatbread to scoop up all those delicious flavours. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish shakshuka
steps.notes: Divide shakshuka, drizzle tahini, scatter dukkah and parsley, and serve with warm flatbread.

Cook for 3–5 minutes, then add the baby spinach and cook for a further minute until wilted. Add a splash of water if the sauce thickens too much or starts to catch on the bottom of the pan. steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, remove the skin and stone from the avocado and dice it into small cubes. Place it in your mixing bowl and squeeze over the juice of half the lime . Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with a little olive oil.

title: Smoky Whole Roasted Aubergine Over Creamy Whipped Tahini With Hot Agave Harissa, Fresh Parsley & Flatbreads

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan and take out two baking trays and a small saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare equipment
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C (or 200°C fan) and gather two baking trays and a small saucepan.

steps.raw_text: Using a fork or the tip of a sharp knife, pierce 8–10 holes, about 2 cm deep, all over each aubergine . This step is important as it allows steam to escape and helps prevent them from bursting in the oven. Place the aubergines on a baking tray and transfer to the oven. Roast for 25–30 minutes, or until they are very soft, slightly collapsed and the skins have split, turning them halfway through so they cook evenly. Alternatively, if you are short on time, quarter the aubergines lengthways and sauté them with a drizzle of oil in a griddle pan or frying pan over high heat for about 5 minutes on each side, until soft and charred all over.
steps.label: Pierce and roast aubergines
steps.notes: Roast for 25–30 minutes (midpoint 28) until soft and skins split, turning halfway. Alternatively, quarter and sauté in a griddle/frying pan for 5 minutes per side.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, pick the parsley leaves and finely chop them, and gently warm the hot agave harissa in a saucepan over low heat. When the aubergines are nearly ready, place the garlic & herb flatbreads on the second baking tray and put them on the lower rack of the oven for 3–5 minutes, until warmed through and slightly crispy in places. STEP 6 To serve, spread the whipped tahini onto a serving plate. Slit each roasted aubergine down the centre and gently open it up to reveal the flesh. Season with salt and pepper, then drizzle over the hot agave harissa. Finish with the chopped parsley , and enjoy!
steps.label: Prep parsley, warm flatbreads, and plate
steps.notes: Chop parsley and warm harissa while aubergines roast. Warm flatbreads in the oven for 3–5 minutes. Plate with whipped tahini, seasoned aubergines, harissa, and parsley.

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle, then take out a saucepan and a large frying pan. Fill your saucepan with boiling water from your kettle, place over a high heat and bring to the boil for the noodles. Crumble the tofu into roughly minced pieces. Dice the chestnut mushrooms into small cubes, around 0.5-1cm. Slice the pak choi into bite-sized pieces. Finely slice the spring onions , keeping the green and white parts separate. This is all your veg prep done.
steps.label: Boil water and prep vegetables and tofu
steps.notes: Boil kettle, crumble tofu, dice mushrooms to 0.5-1cm, slice pak choi, and separate spring onion whites and greens.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium heat and add the peanuts and walnuts . Dry fry them (without oil) for 3-4 minutes or until nicely toasted, tossing occasionally so they don't burn. Set aside and roughly chop or crush them by pressing down on them with a rolling pin or bottom of a heavy pan. Wipe the pan clean with kitchen towel.
steps.label: Toast and crush nuts
steps.notes: Dry fry peanuts and walnuts for 3-4 minutes, crush with a rolling pin or heavy pan, then wipe the frying pan clean.

steps.raw_text: Place your frying pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of oil (sesame oil works well, but any oil will do). Once hot, add the white parts of the spring onions and the crumbled tofu , and cook until the tofu begins to crisp up. Add the diced chestnut mushrooms and continue cooking until everything is nicely browned. Toss in the sliced pak choi and cook until just softened but still slightly crunchy. Turn off the heat, then pour in two-thirds of the dan dan sauce and stir well to coat. Add a splash of water if needed to achieve a saucy consistency. Note: For a four-person kit, you may need to use two frying pans to brown the tofu and mushrooms separately before combining them in one pan with the sauce.
steps.label: Cook tofu, mushrooms, and pak choi
steps.notes: Cook spring onion whites and tofu until crisp, add mushrooms until browned, toss in pak choi until soft, then stir in two-thirds of the dan dan sauce.

steps.raw_text: Meanwhile, add the udon noodles to your saucepan of boiling water and cook for 5-6 minutes, or until tender but still al dente. Once cooked, drain and rinse the noodles under cold water - this helps remove excess starch and prevents them from becoming soggy. Set them aside in a colander to drain while you wait for the mince to finish.
steps.label: Boil and rinse udon noodles
steps.notes: Cook noodles for 5-6 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water to remove excess starch.

steps.raw_text: Boil your kettle again, then set the colander with the rinsed udon noodles over the sink and pour the boiling water over them to warm them up. Drain well.
steps.label: Reheat noodles with boiling water
steps.notes: Boil kettle again and pour boiling water over the cold noodles in the colander to warm them up.

steps.raw_text: To serve up, divide the cooked noodles between serving bowls. Top with the dan dan mince and drizzle over the remaining dan dan sauce . Finish with the spring onion and toasted peanut and walnut garnish. Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and garnish bowls
steps.notes: Divide noodles, top with mince, drizzle remaining sauce, and garnish with spring onions and toasted nuts.

steps.raw_text: Slice the aubergine into 1cm rounds, then place your frying pan over a medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil. Once hot, add your aubergine pieces and fry for around 5-10 minutes on each side or until tender. Season with salt and pepper during the final 30 seconds of cooking.
steps.label: Slice and fry aubergine

steps.raw_text: While the aubergine cooks, finely slice the oyster mushrooms . Once the aubergine is cooked, add another drizzle of oil to the same frying pan, turn the heat up to the highest setting and fry the mushrooms for 5-10 minutes or until crispy and golden. Season with some salt or soy sauce during the final 30 seconds of cooking.
steps.label: Slice and fry oyster mushrooms

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan over a medium heat, pour boiling water into the pan from your kettle and add the flat rice noodles (two nests for two people). Cook for 4-5 minutes, then drain the noodles . Rinse the noodles to stop them sticking together.
steps.label: Cook and rinse rice noodles

steps.raw_text: Pour the laksa sauce into another saucepan along with 250ml of water, place over a medium heat and bring to the boil. title: Spring Buckwheat Galette With Asparagus, Mushroom & Spinach In Wild Garlic Sauce With Dressed Salad

steps.raw_text: Take out two large frying pans (one for the vegetables and one for the pancakes, for which we highly recommend a non-stick pan).
steps.label: Prepare frying pans
steps.notes: Set aside one pan for vegetables and one non-stick pan for the pancakes.

steps.raw_text: (Optional) Blend half of the baby spinach into the wild garlic sauce until smooth to create a vibrant green sauce like the picture. Set aside. Remove the woody ends from the asparagus and cut into 3-4 pieces. Thinly slice the chestnut mushrooms. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in one frying pan over medium heat. Add the hazelnuts to toast for 2-3 minutes, then remove and set aside. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, then add the asparagus and cook for a further 5 minutes. Finally, add the remaining spinach leaves and cook for 2 more minutes, until wilted. Season with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Prep and cook vegetables
steps.notes: Optional blending of spinach into sauce. Toast hazelnuts for 2-3 minutes. Cook mushrooms for 5 minutes, asparagus for 5 minutes, and spinach for 2 minutes.

steps.raw_text: In a mixing bowl or jug, combine the galette batter with 240ml of water (double for 4 portions) and 2 teaspoons of neutral oil. Whisk until smooth and free of lumps. If you have some to hand, add a dash of lemon juice or vinegar to help activate the baking powder in the batter mix.
steps.label: Whisk galette batter
steps.notes: Whisk batter with water and oil until smooth. Optional: add lemon juice or vinegar to activate baking powder.

steps.raw_text: Use a second frying pan (a non-stick pan is highly recommended) for the pancakes. Place over medium heat and add a drizzle of oil to coat the base. Pour in half of the galette batter and swirl to spread it thinly and evenly. Cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until cooked through and dry to the touch but not crispy. You can slide the pancake off onto a plate or chopping board and then turn the pan upside down onto the plate to help you flip it. Repeat with the second pancake.
steps.label: Cook galette pancakes
steps.notes: Cook each pancake for 2-3 minutes on each side over medium heat. Repeat for the second pancake.

steps.raw_text: To serve, spread a couple of spoonfuls of the wild garlic sauce over each galette and top with the mushrooms , asparagus , and spinach . Fold the edges towards the centre to form a square (optional). Drizzle over the remaining sauce and season with salt and freshly ground pepper. Serve with a mixed leaf salad dressed with French vinaigrette and scattered with toasted hazelnuts . Enjoy!
steps.label: Assemble and serve galettes
steps.notes: Spread sauce, top with cooked vegetables, fold edges to form a square, and serve with dressed mixed leaf salad and toasted hazelnuts.

Butternut Squash, Apricot & Chickpea Tagine With Toasted Almonds, Lemon Yoghurt, Fresh Parsley & Wholewheat Cous Cous

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan, boil your kettle, and take out a baking tray and a large saucepan.
steps.label: Preheat oven and boil kettle
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan. Boil kettle for the couscous.

steps.raw_text: Peel the butternut squash , trim the ends, and cut it in half to remove the seeds. Dice into 2 cm cubes and place them on your baking tray. Add a generous drizzle of olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss well to coat evenly. Roast in the oven for 18–20 minutes, until golden and crispy at the edges.
steps.label: Prep and roast butternut squash
steps.notes: Roast for 18–20 minutes (midpoint 19 mins used for roast time) until golden and crispy at the edges.

steps.raw_text: Pour the wholemeal couscous into a heatproof dish and add 100 ml of boiling water from the kettle. For a 4-person portion, use double the water. Stir, then cover with a plate and leave to steam while you prepare the tagine.
steps.label: Steam the wholemeal couscous

steps.raw_text: Place your large saucepan over medium-high heat. Toast the flaked almonds by dry frying (without oil) for 60 seconds or until golden. Remove and set aside. Then add the tagine sauce and the tin of chickpeas (including the liquid) to the same saucepan. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and leave to simmer gently.
steps.label: Toast almonds and simmer tagine
steps.notes: Toast almonds dry for 60 seconds until golden. Simmer tagine gently on low heat.

steps.raw_text: Finely chop half of the parsley leaves and stir them into the pres erved lemon yo ghurt . Pick the remaining parsley leaves from the stems to use as a garnish. Fluff up the steamed wholemeal couscous and season with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt.
steps.label: Prepare herb yoghurt and couscous
steps.notes: Chop half the parsley for the yoghurt and keep the rest whole for garnish. Fluff couscous with olive oil and salt.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the wholemeal couscous between serving bowls and ladle the tagine sauce into the centre. Top with the roasted butternut squash cubes and drizzle over the herby preserved lemon yoghurt . Finish with a garnish of flaked almonds and parsley leaves. Enjoy!

title: Butternut Squash & White Bean Gratin In Rich & Creamy Cashew, White Wine & Mustard Sauce With Cavolo Nero

steps.raw_text: Preheat your oven to 220°C / 200°C fan. Take out a frying pan, and an oven proof casserole dish or a saucepan and a baking dish if you don't have one.
steps.label: Preheat oven and prepare dishes
steps.notes: Preheat oven to 220°C or 200°C fan. Gather the required pans and dishes.

steps.raw_text: Halve the butternut squash , peel it, and remove the pulp and seeds with a spoon. Slice the squash very thinly, about 2mm thick. You can use a vegetable peeler or a mandoline if you have one. *For this recipe, 500–550g of fresh squash is required, so if you have received a very large squash, you can save the rest for another meal or roast it separately on the side.
steps.label: Prep and slice butternut squash
steps.notes: Halve, peel, and seed the squash. Slice very thinly to about 2mm thick. Use 500-550g.

steps.raw_text: Place your saucepan or oven-proof casserole dish over medium heat. Add the tin of cannellini beans including the brine and add three quarters of the creamy gratin sauce , reserving the rest for the end. Cook until piping hot and then remove from the heat. If you're using an oven proof casserole dish, arrange the squash over the top of the creamy beans, without overlapping too much. Don't do more than one single layer or it may not cook through. If you're using an oven dish, transfer the creamy beans from your saucepan to the dish and arrange the squash over the top of the beans. Drizzle olive oil over the top and season well with salt and pepper. Roast for 30 minutes or until the squash is cooked through, then add the remaining gratin sauce and roast for a further 5-10 minutes or until it browns a little.
steps.label: Cook beans and roast gratin
steps.notes: Cook beans and 3/4 of the sauce until hot. Arrange squash in a single layer on top. Roast for 30 minutes, add remaining sauce, and roast 5-10 minutes more.

steps.raw_text: In the meantime, remove the tough stems from the cavolo nero and slice the leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place your frying pan over medium heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the cavolo nero along with a splash of water and sauté until wilted and vibrant green, about 6–8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
steps.label: Prep and sauté cavolo nero
steps.notes: Slice leaves into bite-sized pieces. Sauté with olive oil and a splash of water for 6-8 minutes until wilted.

steps.raw_text: To serve, divide the gratin between plates and serve with the sautéed cavolo nero on the side. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and serve the gratin
steps.notes: Divide the gratin between plates and serve with the sautéed cavolo nero on the side.

title: Sri Lankan Daal With Crispy Courgette & Corn Fritters, Date Tamarind Chutney & Organic Soy Yoghurt

steps.raw_text: Take out a large saucepan, a large frying pan and a large mixing bowl.
steps.label: Gather cooking equipment and bowls
steps.notes: Take out a large saucepan, a large frying pan, and a large mixing bowl to prepare for cooking.

steps.raw_text: Grate the courgette then place it into a sieve or perforated colander rested over a bowl or colander. Toss it in a large pinch of sea salt, set aside for 10 minutes, then squeeze and drain as much liquid as you can from the courgette. If you don't do this your fritters won't crisp up.
steps.label: Grate, salt, and drain courgette
steps.notes: Set the salted courgette aside for 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible to ensure crispy fritters.

steps.raw_text: Add the sri lankan daal sauce, red lentils and 300ml of water (or 600ml for a 4 person box) to your saucepan and cook for 10-15 mins until the lentils are soft and tender. Stir occasionally while cooking and add a splash of water as needed if it reduces too much or starts to stick. Season to taste with salt.
steps.label: Cook the Sri Lankan daal
steps.notes: Cook for 10-15 minutes until lentils are soft and tender. Stir occasionally and add water if it sticks.

steps.raw_text: Drain the sweetcorn and add it into your large mixing bowl with the squeezed courgette and fritter dry batter . Season well with salt and pepper. You may need to add a little water to bind the batter mix. The less water you use, the crispier your fritters will be so start with 50ml and add more if needed until the mix is just starting to stick together (it will bind better once it's fried!).
steps.label: Mix the fritter batter
steps.notes: Drain sweetcorn and mix with courgette and dry batter. Start with 50ml water and add more only if needed to bind.

steps.raw_text: Heat a drizzle of oil in your frying pan over a medium heat. Add a large spoonful of the batter mix to the pan and press down to form a 1cm thick fritter (they don’t need to be perfect circles!). Cook each side for 4-5 minutes or until golden and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter.
steps.label: Fry the corn fritters
steps.notes: Cook fritters over medium heat for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

steps.raw_text: Divide the sri lankan daal between serving bowls, top with the spiced courgette and corn fritters, drizzle over the soy yoghurt and date tamarind chutney , and garnish the dish with a few picked coriander leaves to finish. Enjoy!
steps.label: Plate and garnish the dish
steps.notes: Divide daal into bowls, top with fritters, drizzle with soy yoghurt and chutney, and garnish with coriander.

title: Sri Lankan Daal With Curry Spiced Oyster Mushroom Skewers & Beetroot Raita Over Fluffy Basmati Rice

steps.raw_text: We highly recommend using a cast iron pan or griddle to char the oyster mushrooms if you have one. If you don't a frying pan will work too. As well as this, take out two saucepans and a mixing bowl.
steps.label: Gather equipment and pans
steps.notes: Take out a cast iron pan, griddle, or frying pan, two saucepans, and a mixing bowl.

steps.raw_text: Add the sri lankan daal sauce, red lentils and 300ml of water (or 600ml for a 4 person box) to one of your saucepans and bring to a simmer, then cook for 10-15 mins until the lentils are soft and tender. Stir occasionally while cooking and add a splash of water as needed if it reduces too much or starts to stick. Season to taste with salt.
steps.label: Simmer the Sri Lankan daal
steps.notes: Cook for 10-15 minutes until lentils are soft and tender. Stir occasionally and add water if needed.

steps.raw_text: Place the basmati rice into one of your saucepans and cover with 1.5x its volume in water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 10-12 minutes until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Remove from the heat and leave to steam with the lid on until the rest of the dish is ready.
steps.label: Cook and steam basmati rice
steps.notes: Simmer for 10-12 minutes until water is absorbed, then leave to steam with the lid on.

steps.raw_text: Tear the oyster mushrooms into 1.5-2cm strips and add them to your mixing bowl along with the oyster mushroom spice mix , a glug of neutral oil and a good amount of salt and pepper. Give everything a good mix with your hands until the mushrooms are well coated in marinade. Thread the marinated oyster mushroom pieces onto the wooden skewers
steps.label: Prep and skewer oyster mushrooms
steps.notes: Tear mushrooms into 1.5-2cm strips, coat with marinade in the bowl, and thread onto skewers.
